_hinweis: Neue Hauptstory Eden Rise (Phase B, 17.10.2026). Gebaut aus werkzeuge\eden_rise\modul_eden_rise.py auf Basis von basis_eden_rise.py - dort aendern, nicht hier. Ablauf: story.json + kern\hauptstory.py.
untertitel: The last charter night. Then the days that change everything.
welt: M/Y Eden Rise, a 62-metre solar-powered superyacht owned by the Eden Group: a hardtop of solar panels, battery banks, a silent electric drive, and one diesel emergency generator the ETO calls Unit-01. The charter season is over; the last guests are influencer Siri Lindvik and her boyfriend Yasin Benali. After a farewell party the yacht was to sail overnight into the bay of Cala d'Orsu for a sunrise photo stop - Megan's "Eden Bay Weekend" - and then on to the shipyard in Calvi for the winter. In the early morning after the party the electric drive failed. She drifted into the bay of Cala d'Orsu, a fishing village of three hundred people on the west coast of Corsica, and lies at anchor out in the bay - the fishing harbour is far too shallow for her, so there is no shore power and no fuel dock; the shore is a tender ride away. The hotel side runs on the batteries in island mode: anchor light and alarm, bilge pumps, the cold rooms, the watermaker, the toilets; the emergency radio has its own supply. Captain Marit Holm was flown out with appendicitis the morning after; Duc, the First Officer, has command. Megan McAllister, Fleet Director of the Eden Group, has given them seven days: then she holds a hearing on board and judges who caused the failure - without a culprit she fires the whole crew. Nobody aboard knows yet what caused the failure.
ziel: In seven days Megan holds a hearing on board: find out who caused the failure.
prolog: The last charter of the season is over. Tonight the Eden Rise sails for the bay of Cala d'Orsu - the Eden Bay Weekend, a sunrise for the cameras. Then the shipyard in Calvi, and the winter.
Tonight there is one more party on the aft deck: the crew, the last two guests, a captain who pretends her stomach is fine, and a cook who swears the sea will glow tonight.
You are the new First Officer, one day aboard. Nobody expects anything of you tonight.

personas.oeffentlich: the new First Officer, aboard since Antibes
personas.vorgeschichte: An ESG consultant from Frankfurt, 33, on a sabbatical: one season at sea as First Officer, Yachtmaster for years. He reads a balance sheet as well as he reads a room, and years of client meetings taught him to win one. He is good with his hands and would rather fix a thing than replace it. In the galley he cooks European and Southeast Asian home cooking, from bun rieu to bouillabaisse. He thinks in plans, plan B and plan C.
personas.geheimnis: A management position at European level is waiting for his answer by the end of this week. It means pressure, an office, no sea. Everyone aboard thinks he is staying at sea.
personas.vorteil: Craft and kitchen: advantage on every repair and building check, and on every cooking check. Head and charm show in a fight: he spots weak points for free and talks with advantage.
personas.schwaeche: Plan for everything: when something goes off-plan he wants to solve it alone. Accepting help is his growth.

reparatur.label: Repairs
reparatur.voll: The Eden Rise runs under her own power again.

rettung.voll: A tug from Ajaccio is on its way.

yasin_video.voll: Yasin's video 'STRANDED ON A BILLIONAIRE YACHT' is online.

toto.name: Totò's Locker
toto.text: A locked locker in the store room. Totò has everything, almost. The better you know him, the better the price.

gruss_0: Comandante! Come in, come in. Don't look at the boxes, the boxes are for the engine room.
A new captain. Good. New captains always need things, and they never know yet what they need. That's where I come in.
Everything in here is legal. Nearly. Nobody has complained so far, and in Naples that's the law.
The prices are on the list. The list is a suggestion, but we don't know each other yet, so I'll pretend it's not.
You want something, I have something. You don't want something, I still have something. That's just how a locker works.
Careful with the door, Comandante, it sticks. It sticks on purpose. Fewer visitors that way.
I'm Totò. Bosun, shopkeeper, cousin to half of Naples. Ask anyone on the boat about me. Except Elsa. Don't ask Elsa.
No, I don't know where it came from. Yes, I can get you another one. Both things are true, so don't make that face.
gruss_1: Comandante, you're back. Good, good. I was starting to think the lock scared you.
Ah, my favourite customer. Don't tell the others. They all think they're my favourite customer.
Be honest, when did you last eat something proper? I have a sandwich. It's mostly bread, but it's bread with feelings.
Elsa was asking about you. Not about me, for once. Congratulations, I'm jealous.
Take your time. Look around. Touch nothing that glows.
The coffee is terrible, Comandante, but it's free. That's the best kind of terrible.
I put a few things aside for you. Not the best things. The best things I'm still deciding about.
Business is slow, which is good. Slow business means nobody is watching.
gruss_2: Comandante! There he is. Sit on the crate, it's the comfortable one. The other crate bites.
My mother says a man who comes back twice is a man you can trust. My mother also says that about cats.
I have a good feeling about today. It's the garlic. Or the weather. Mostly the garlic.
Rosi beat me at arm wrestling again. Don't say anything. If you say anything, the prices go up.
Tell me what you need and I'll tell you what it costs. Then we're both a little disappointed, and then we have a deal.
You're the first captain who says thank you when I hand him something. Don't stop. It's confusing and I like it.
I've been practising a bet on you. Two to one that you walk out with something you didn't come for.
Careful, Comandante, I'm starting to enjoy these visits. It's bad for business.
gruss_3: Come in, close the door. No, not for a secret. The draught is bad for the cheese.
Do you want to hear something silly? I'd like a market stall. In the village, with a stamp from the town hall. Nobody in my family ever sold anything with a stamp.
A man in my position meets a lot of people, Comandante. Most of them I wouldn't leave alone with my wallet. You I'd leave with my wallet and the keys.
Jana tied her first bowline today. I nearly cried. Don't tell her, she thinks I only cry at football.
Good price today, and I'm not even trying to cheat you. I checked twice. It feels strange, I'm not used to it.
My cousin called from Bastia. He says hello. He says a lot of other things too, mostly about money, but hello comes first.
You're good to this crew, you know. People notice. I notice. I wrote it in the book, next to the bets I lost on purpose.
Sit down, eat something. We'll talk prices once you have a full stomach. That's how it's done in Naples.
gruss_4: Comandante. For you, the family price. Not the one I tell Megan's drone. The real one.
I told my mother about you. She says you sound too thin. She's praying for you now. That's good news, she doesn't pray for everyone.
Whatever you need, you ask me first. Before Elsa, before Chiara. I won't tell them I'm better.
Nobody comes into my locker without knocking. You can come in without knocking. Don't make it a habit. No, okay, make it a habit.
You know what I like about you? You don't ask where things come from, and you pay. Both. It's rare. It's like a rainbow.
I kept the good bottle for you, behind the life jackets. If Chiara finds it, it was a gift from the sea.
When Elsa finally takes me away, you'll water my basil, yes? It's the only honest thing I own.
Eh. Comandante. It's good to see you. Is that strange to say? It is. Don't make a face.
gruss_5: My brother! No, don't correct me. It's what you are now. Naples never forgets, and neither do I.
Take whatever you want, I'll write it in the book. The book is a lie. The book has been a lie for years, but a loving one.
I'll tell you something one day, Comandante. Not today. Today I sell you a fish and we're both happy.
Do you know what it means to have someone at the door you don't have to check first? It means I sleep. A little. Mostly.
For you, everything is on the house. Everything except the things that aren't. That's most of it. But the feeling is on the house.
When I get my stall with the stamp, the first sale is for you. First sale is always free. My mother's rule. Also a terrible business plan.
You pulled me out of a very bad week, Comandante, and you never asked for a share. I'm still waiting for the catch.
Sit. Eat. Tell me about your day. I'm not selling anything, I just want to hear it. That's new for me. I like it.
kauf: Excellent choice! You have taste, Comandante.
Pleasure doing business. And remember, you didn't buy it here.
kauf_intim: Ah. Ah! Comandante. No, I don't ask. I only wonder, very loudly, inside my head, who it's for.
No receipt, no warranty, no witnesses. I have never respected a man's privacy so much.
I wrapped it twice. Once for the gift, once for your dignity.
kauf_schmuck: Something that shines! Who's it for, Comandante? Don't answer. I'm nosy, but I'm discreet.
Good eye. Small things shine the most. That's why I wear a very large chain.
Real? Real enough that nobody asks. And that's the only real that matters at sea.
kauf_papier: Paper! Somebody is going to feel very understood. Who? Don't tell me, let me guess for a week.
A gift you can read. Good, Comandante. Things you can read last longer than things you can eat.
They say the pen is mightier than the sword. I've seen Maxwell. I'd still bet on Maxwell.
kauf_technik: A thing with parts! Whoever gets that will say 'Oh' first and 'Thank you' second. I've seen it happen.
Batteries not included. Batteries never are. It's the oldest joke in the world and I still fall for it.
I'd tell you it works. But I'm a man of honour. I'd tell you it probably works.
kauf_essen: Food as a gift. Good. Nobody ever says 'I hate it' to the person who brought food. Except Maxwell, once. About broccoli.
Give it fast or eat it fast, Comandante. A present that goes soft has a short career.
For somebody hungry, or for somebody you'd like to stay a little longer? Don't answer. I like not knowing.
kauf_alkohol: Now we're talking. A bottle is the best way to say 'I thought about you' without having to talk.
Taste the first sip yourself. It's a rule. A Neapolitan rule, I just made it up, but it's still a rule.
I'll write it down as 'medicinal'. It's what I always write. Nobody has ever asked what for.
kauf_party: Noise and glitter! Somebody will have a very good day, Comandante. And somebody else will have to clean up.
A present with confetti. I've been to less joyful weddings.
Don't open it in the engine room. Rosi will tell you why. Loudly.
kauf_natur: From the sea or the earth, no tax, no stamp. The best presents come that way.
Natural things! My mother would approve. She'd complain about the price, but she'd approve.
Hold it gently. It's alive. Or it was. Or it will be, if you're lucky.
kauf_kampf: For fighting! I like a man who is prepared. I like a man who is prepared and also pays.
Try not to need it, Comandante. But if you do, you'll thank me, and I'll say it was nothing. It was something. It was the price.
Take it. And if someone hits you, hit them back. Politely. Neapolitan style.
kauf_schmuggel: I don't know where that came from. I never knew. Do you know what a clean conscience is? An empty head.
Put it somewhere dry. And somewhere Elsa doesn't look. Those are two different places.
Between us, it's very good. Between us. If it ever comes up, I was in Naples.
kauf_ressource: Supplies! Practical. Boring. Necessary. My three favourite words on a receipt.
Without these the boat is just a very expensive raft. I'm glad you thought of it.
Take it, Comandante, and tell Rosi it was her idea. She always likes that.
kauf_werkzeug: A tool. Good. A man with a good tool is dangerous. A man with a good tool and a plan is Rosi.
It's heavy because it's good. That's what I tell my cousin about everything.
Treat it well. A tool you love is a tool that doesn't hit your thumb. Mostly.
hinweis_intim_sophia: If you're asking who'd like that, I'll say this much: somebody with a little brown notebook who never tells you what's in it. I'm not saying a name. I'm saying notebook.
hinweis_intim_lola: That one would get a laugh out of the galley. Somebody down there laughs at her own jokes, and I'd like to be in the room when she opens it.
hinweis_intim_alva: The woman with the only bar in the village sees everything and tells nobody. If she got that, she'd know who sent it before you did.
hinweis_schmuck_chiara: Somebody on this boat gives everything a number out of ten. This one would get a nine, and then she'd wear it every day without telling a soul.
hinweis_schmuck_sophia: A person who calls everyone darling would say nothing at all when she opens that. For her, that's a love letter.
hinweis_schmuck_alva: Put that on the bar in front of the right woman and she'll pretend not to look. For about two seconds.
hinweis_schmuck_megan: There's a boss on the mainland who likes small, expensive things she can pretend she never wanted. This is small. This is expensive. I'm only describing a ring.
hinweis_schmuck_yasin: A man with a very large watch always has room for one more shiny thing. I'm not naming names. I'm naming the watch.
hinweis_schmuck_casanova: If the mayor sees it, Comandante, there will be a speech. A long one. With music. I'm only warning you.
hinweis_papier_chiara: Paper and pens make a certain person very happy. She has a clipboard for everything. She even rates her clipboards.
hinweis_papier_sophia: Nice paper, a good pen. That's for a woman who writes things down and closes the book when you walk in.
hinweis_papier_siri: There's a girl on the foredeck who apologises to chairs. Give her something to write in and she'll apologise to the page, but she'll write.
hinweis_papier_holm: The captain reads a checklist the way other people read love poems. Nobody dares say it. I just said it. Please don't tell her.
hinweis_papier_petru: Old Petru has a drawer full of charts and nobody to show them to. Something with paper and a little sea in it. He'd say 'Hm.' That means yes.
hinweis_papier_megan: Fine paper, serious paper, paper that says 'I'm in charge'. There's someone in a very tall building who'd like that. She'd never say thank you without a condition.
hinweis_technik_rosi: Anything with a switch, a dial or a very sad cable. There's a woman in the engine room who talks to her tools. She'd be talking to this one by lunchtime.
hinweis_technik_yasin: Anything with a screen or a camera. A man who films everything would film the box before he opened it.
hinweis_technik_elsa: For the coast guard, anything that takes batteries and doesn't need a form. She'd call it evidence. She'd keep it.
hinweis_technik_lea: Our little diver likes things that go underwater, or at least try. She'd tell you three facts about it before you could say thank you.
hinweis_essen_holm: The captain eats what's in front of her and says nothing. That means it's good. Make it salty, she has Norway in the blood.
hinweis_essen_elsa: Somebody in a uniform, with a boat and two men, would eat that too. She'll call it a courtesy and write it down.
hinweis_essen_petru: The old fisherman likes simple. Bread, cheese, a bit of salt. He'd say 'Hm.' and mean 'sit down'.
hinweis_essen_casanova: The mayor would call that a feast and make a speech about it. Bring it near the village, and bring earplugs.
hinweis_alkohol_lola: Somebody in the galley says she cooks with wine. I think half goes in the pot. The other half goes in the cook.
hinweis_alkohol_alva: A gift for the woman who owns a bar? She'll grade it like a judge and then drink it like a friend.
hinweis_alkohol_megan: Somebody on the mainland drinks single malt and calls it a quiet moment. She'd ask what it cost. And then she'd keep it.
hinweis_alkohol_petru: The old man at the harbour has a bottle he never opens and a friend he never mentions. A good one would start a story. Maybe two.
hinweis_party_lola: Somebody who makes the whole galley sing would love that. She says it's for the mood. Mostly it's for the cheese.
hinweis_party_alva: Noise and glitter for the woman with the bar. She'll put it next to the bottles and pretend she bought it herself.
hinweis_party_casanova: The mayor lives for that. You give her confetti, she gives you the village. Do you want the village? I'd think about it.
hinweis_party_lea: Our young diver would hang it on the dive locker and call it a celebration. For no reason. That's the best kind.
verkauf: Mm. It's worth less than you think. But I'll give you more than it's worth, because I'm stupid.
Don't ask where it goes. It goes where it's loved.
Cash, no receipt. The best kind of cash.
pleite: No money? Comandante... even I can't sell air. Not yet.
The prices won't jump into your pocket on their own. Come back with more, and I'll pretend I never saw this.
Empty pockets, Comandante? Madonna. Sit, have a coffee. The coffee is on the house. Only the coffee.

alva.name: Alva's Bar
alva.text: The only bar in Cala d'Orsu, and since the quarrel over the village shop the only shop too. Alva sells everything, diesel under the counter included.

lola.name: Lola's Galley
lola.text: The galley smells of butter, sugar and something nobody talks about. One meal a day: eat it yourself or give it away.

megan.name: Eden Shop
megan.text: Spare parts and Eden goods, ordered by video call from the fleet director and delivered with the next supply boat. From trust level 3 with Megan there is a discount.

rosi.name: Rosi's Workshop
rosi.text: Rosi's workshop on the lower deck: chips fitted, weapons and jackets upgraded.

isabelle.name: San Martinu Pharmacy
isabelle.text: Isabelle's herbal remedies from the monastery pharmacy. Order by phone, and Frederico brings it down to the harbour with the goat cart.

nonna.name: Nonna's Farm
nonna.text: Beds, sheds and a very opinionated goat. Nonna sells what she can spare, and Frederico runs it down to the harbour.

petru.name: Petru's Workshop
petru.text: Nets, a blue boat on trestles and a radio that only plays Corsican football. Petru sells tools now, because someone has to pay for the diesel.

danzel.name: Le Théâtre Rouge
danzel.text: The old room on the piazza with the good window. One red curtain, one mannequin, and a man who measures you with his eyes before he says hello.

batu.name: Bà Tư's Shop
batu.text: Too many shelves for the room, a wall of amber bottles and a small Virgin Mary with a fresh flower. The pot at the back is always on.

mochis.name: Mochi's
mochis.text: An old shepherds' estate on the terraces above the bay, with a barn that has half a roof, a very neat sign and a long row of bowls. Bibi keeps a field book here, and she is the only one who can read it.

gesten.label: Compliment
gesten.handlung: He pays {n} a sincere, specific compliment.

gesten.label: Ask something real
gesten.handlung: He asks {n} something real about herself - and actually listens.

gesten.label: Comfort
gesten.handlung: He notices something weighs on {n} and comforts her.

gesten.label: Apologise
gesten.handlung: He apologises to {n}, honestly, without excuses.

gesten.label: Share your secret
gesten.handlung: He tells {n} what he hasn't told anyone aboard: a firm in Frankfurt wants his answer by the end of this week, and he doesn't know what to say.

gesten.label: Brush her hair back
gesten.handlung: He brushes a strand of hair from {n}'s face.

gesten.label: Massage
gesten.handlung: He offers {n} a massage and works the tension out of her shoulders.

gesten.label: Ask her out tonight
gesten.handlung: He asks {n} to spend the evening with him - just the two of them.

gesten.label: Confess your feelings
gesten.handlung: He tells {n} plainly that he has feelings for her.

gesten.label: Talk about jealousy
gesten.handlung: He asks {n} straight out whether something about him and the others is bothering her.

gesten.label: Make a promise
gesten.handlung: He makes {n} a serious promise about what comes after this week.

gesten.label: Go somewhere private
gesten.handlung: He quietly asks {n} to come with him somewhere they can be alone.

gesten.label: Foreplay
gesten.handlung: He draws {n} close and starts touching her, slow and deliberate.

gesten.label: Sleep with her
gesten.handlung: He and {n} end up in bed together.

multitool.label: Storm of '09 Multitool
multitool.text: A well-worn stainless multitool with eleven functions and one that nobody has ever figured out. Alva swears it opened a bottle of wine during the storm of '09.
multitool.wirkung_text: Once a day, advantage on Cunning.

holm_compass.label: Holm's Brass Compass
holm_compass.text: Brass, scratched glass, a needle that still finds north. It belonged to Holm's father. She gave it to you at the gangway, without a speech.

petru_key.label: Key to Petru's Workshop
petru_key.text: Iron, heavy, tied to a cork float so it won't sink. Petru doesn't give his key to people. He gives it to people he'd let into his boat.

festa_invite.label: The Mayor's Invitation to the Festa
festa_invite.text: Thick cream card, a red wax seal, a sprig of myrtle. Madame Casanova signed it with three exclamation marks. One would have been a lot.

serial_mismatch.label: Serial number that doesn't match the logbook

power_log.label: Power log: load on the bridge at 02:10

gps_track.label: GPS track with a detour towards the Esterel

burnt_cable.label: Charred charging cable from the VIP cabin

arancini.label: Arancini from the Bakery
arancini.text: Golden, still warm, wrapped in greaseproof paper. The village bakery makes exactly twelve a morning. By nine, there are none.

olive_oil.label: Hill Grove Olive Oil
olive_oil.text: Green-gold, bottled by hand with a paper label. The groves above Cala d'Orsu are older than the church. Some families still argue about which tree is theirs.

lolas_gewuerz.label: Lola's Spice Mix “Ocean Glitter”
lolas_gewuerz.text: A jar of salt, chilli and something that sparkles. Lola won't say what. It goes on everything, and everything is better for it.

tim_tams.label: Tim Tams from Alva's Bar
tim_tams.text: Chocolate biscuits from the other side of the world, in a packet slightly crushed by the journey. Nobody in Corsica knows how Alva gets them.

lolas_kekse.label: A Plate of Lola's Biscuits
lolas_kekse.text: Buttery, uneven, a little burnt at one edge. Lola bakes them at three in the morning when she can't sleep. Even people who swear off sugar don't say no.

feigen.label: Market Figs from Cala d'Orsu
feigen.text: Purple figs, split open by the sun. Alva buys them from a woman who won't sell to anyone she doesn't like.

proteinriegel.label: Totò's Gym-Box Protein Bar
proteinriegel.text: Forty grams of protein and the taste of cardboard with ambition. Totò keeps a box of them for the gym people. He won't eat one himself.

franzbroetchen.label: Hamburg Cinnamon Roll (Homemade)
franzbroetchen.text: Flattened, sticky with cinnamon, folded the way they do it up north. Lola helped. You can tell, because there's a little glitter in it.

canistrelli.label: Fishermen's Aniseed Canistrelli
canistrelli.text: Hard Corsican biscuits that taste of aniseed and keep for months. Fishermen took them out to sea when the bread would have gone soft.

myrtle.label: Cala d'Orsu Myrtle Liqueur
myrtle.text: Dark as a bruise and twice as sweet. Every family in Cala d'Orsu swears theirs is the original recipe. Alva keeps hers under the counter, next to the diesel.

single_malt.label: Islay Single Malt (Fell Off a Boat)
single_malt.text: Peat smoke in a bottle, from a cold island far to the north. It costs more than Totò's monthly rent. He says the case fell off a very expensive boat.

limoncello.label: Homemade Limoncello
limoncello.text: Bright yellow, ice cold, made in someone's kitchen. Alva doesn't sell the recipe. She does sell the bottle, and the bottle is enough.

cap_corse.label: Six O'Clock Cap Corse
cap_corse.text: A bitter Corsican aperitif with quinine and orange peel. The old men at the harbour drink it at six, every day, as if the clock depended on it.

pink_pearl.label: Pink Pearl on a Fine Chain
pink_pearl.text: A single pink pearl on a chain as fine as a hair. Totò wrapped it in tissue paper, which is how you know he didn't steal this one.

designer_perfume.label: Monte Carlo Designer Perfume
designer_perfume.text: A faceted bottle with a heavy gold cap. Smells of money, cold rooms and someone who always gets the last word.

shell_anklet.label: Village Girls' Shell Anklet
shell_anklet.text: Tiny white shells threaded on a silver chain. Alva says the village girls wear them until they marry, and then never take them off.

herzbrille.label: Heart-Shaped Diva Sunglasses
herzbrille.text: Enormous heart-shaped sunglasses with rhinestones on the corners. Subtle as a brass band. Somebody in Cala d'Orsu will wear these with total dignity.

goldkette.label: Thick Gold Chain (Probably Real)
goldkette.text: Heavy enough to anchor a dinghy. Totò swears it's real. Totò also swore the goat was a gift.

designer_sonnenbrille.label: “Original” Designer Sunglasses
designer_sonnenbrille.text: Black lenses, a logo you can read from the other end of the harbour. Totò calls them “original”. He does not say original what.

silberring.label: Slim Silver Ring from the Market
silberring.text: A slim silver band from the Saturday market. Nothing engraved, nothing promised. Just a ring that fits.

torque_wrench.label: Newton-Perfect Torque Wrench
torque_wrench.text: Chrome, precise to the newton metre, in a case that clicks like a safe. A tool for people who think “tight enough” is a moral failing.

dive_torch.label: Night-Dive Torch with a Scratched Fish
dive_torch.text: Yellow, rubber-armoured, bright enough to turn the night sea green. Whoever owned it before scratched a small fish into the handle.

moka.label: Neapolitan Moka Pot
moka.text: A dented aluminium moka pot, the eight-sided kind from Naples. It hisses, it spits, and it makes coffee nobody on this boat can argue with.

selfie_stick.label: Carbon Selfie Stick
selfie_stick.text: Carbon fibre, telescopic, with a remote shutter. It folds down to the size of a pen and opens up to the size of an ego.

polbrille.label: Coast Guard Polarised Sunglasses
polbrille.text: Plain polarised sunglasses, the kind that let you see straight through the glare into the water. Coast guards wear them. So do smugglers.

schweizer_messer.label: Tourist's Red Pocket Knife
schweizer_messer.text: A red pocket knife with nine tools and a toothpick nobody uses. Alva sells exactly one a summer, always to a tourist who swears it's for camping.

fountain_pen.label: Black Lacquer Fountain Pen
fountain_pen.text: Black lacquer, a gold nib, a cap that closes with a soft click. A pen like this doesn't sign receipts. It signs things that matter.

notebook.label: Empty Leather Notebook
notebook.text: Brown leather with an elastic band, every page still empty. The kind of notebook you buy for the person you want to become.

gedichtband.label: Underlined Book of Poems
gedichtband.text: A second-hand book of poems, the spine cracked open at one page. Someone underlined a single line in pencil, then tried to rub it out.

almanac.label: Sailor's Nautical Almanac
almanac.text: Tide tables, star charts and sunrise times, bound in dark blue cloth. Sailors who still trust paper over satellites keep one by their bunk.

old_chart.label: Hand-Drawn Chart of the West Coast
old_chart.text: A yellowed chart of the west coast, the rocks drawn by hand. Some of the soundings are wrong now. The sea has moved, the chart hasn't.

pinup_magazin.label: Totò's Magazine “for the Interviews”
pinup_magazin.text: An Italian men's magazine from the eighties, the cover a little sun-bleached. Totò claims he only reads it for the interviews.

ducs_gedicht.label: Duc's Poem about the Sea
ducs_gedicht.text: A folded page in your own handwriting, crossed out twice and started again. It is not a good poem. It is an honest one.

muschelkette_kinder.label: Homemade Shell Necklace with Beads
muschelkette_kinder.text: Shells and plastic beads on a fishing line, knotted by small hands. One shell is upside down. Nobody would fix it for the world.

pretty_shell.label: Spiral Shell with the Sea Inside
pretty_shell.text: A spiral shell, cream outside and pink inside, the kind children press to their ear. If you listen, the sea is still in there.

seeglas.label: Green Sea Glass
seeglas.text: A piece of green bottle glass, worn smooth and cloudy by years of waves. Somebody's broken bottle became somebody else's treasure.

alvas_rose.label: Alva's Rose
alvas_rose.text: A single red rose from the vase on Alva's bar. She never gives the roses away. She gave you one.

wool_socks.label: Hand-Knitted Wool Socks
wool_socks.text: Grey wool, a plain Nordic pattern, one heel knitted a little thicker than the other. Whoever made them was counting on cold nights at sea.

wollmuetze.label: Unclaimed Norwegian Wool Hat
wollmuetze.text: A thick wool hat with a snowflake pattern, completely wrong for Corsica. It was ordered for a Norwegian guest years ago. He never came back for it.

candles.label: Scented Candles “Maquis”
candles.text: Three candles that smell of the hills: myrtle, rosemary and warm stone. Light one and the cabin turns into the maquis at dusk.

messing_anker.label: Brass Anchor from the Bay
messing_anker.text: A small brass anchor on a keyring, green with salt, fished out of the bay. Whatever keys it once held are still somewhere at the bottom.

macchia_strauss.label: Bouquet from the Macchia
macchia_strauss.text: Wild myrtle, rosemary and a sprig of something yellow nobody can name. Picked on the hillside, it smells of the whole island at once.

korallenzweig.label: Storm-Washed Coral Branch
korallenzweig.text: A small branch of red coral, washed up after a storm. The old fishermen say coral keeps you from drowning. The old fishermen also say a lot of things.

bauchnabelpiercing.label: Belly Button Piercing with a Shell
bauchnabelpiercing.text: A little silver bar with a white shell dangling from it. Alva keeps it in a dish by the till, next to the matches, for the kind of customer who asks.

eden_cap.label: Eden Fleet Cap
eden_cap.text: Navy blue, embroidered with a golden anchor. Megan's office ships them by the hundred. Nobody in the fleet has ever been seen wearing one.

goldfisch.label: Goldfish in a Water Bag
goldfisch.text: A small orange fish in a plastic bag of water, won at the Festa. It looks at you as if this was entirely your idea.

konfetti.label: Bag of Festa Confetti
konfetti.text: A paper bag of glitter confetti, enough for a wedding or a small war. Whoever opens it will be finding it in their hair for weeks.

schaerpe.label: Glitter Sash “Miss Cala d'Orsu”
schaerpe.text: A glitter sash that reads “Miss Cala d'Orsu”. The village crowned its last Miss in 1987. The sash has been waiting ever since.

faecher.label: Sevilla Flamenco Fan
faecher.text: A black lace fan from Sevilla, painted with red carnations. It snaps open like a slap. Someone once danced with it until the floor gave up.

lichterkette.label: Solar Fairy Lights in Glass Drops
lichterkette.text: A string of tiny solar lights in glass drops. Charge them in the sun on deck, and at night the railing looks like it's holding stars.

ukulele.label: Pineapple-Sticker Ukulele
ukulele.text: A second-hand ukulele with a sticker of a pineapple and one string slightly out of tune. It cannot play a sad song. Believe us, people have tried.

massage_oil.label: Neroli Massage Oil
massage_oil.text: Neroli and sweet almond in a dark glass bottle. Warm it in your hands first. That's not a tip, that's a promise.

silk_blindfold.label: Silk Blindfold
silk_blindfold.text: Midnight silk, lined so nothing gets through. Totò hands it over without a single word, which for Totò is a first.

silk_kimono.label: Silk Kimono
silk_kimono.text: Black silk with red cranes, light enough to fall off a shoulder by accident. Accidents like that are the whole point.

massage_candle.label: Massage Candle with Warming Oil
massage_candle.text: A candle that melts into warm oil. Alva wraps it in brown paper and doesn't ask questions, which is its own kind of question.

stockings.label: Lace-Top Hold-Up Stockings
stockings.text: Sheer black stockings with a lace top that stays up on its own. The invoice calls them “luxury textiles”, between the towels and the tablecloths.

satin_ties.label: Satin Bed Restraints
satin_ties.text: Four satin ribbons with soft cuffs, made to fit any bed. Totò's note says “for tying up loose ends”. He's very proud of that one.

nipple_clamps.label: Nipple Clamps with a Chain
nipple_clamps.text: Two little clamps on a fine silver chain, adjustable, as the box assures you three times. Totò pretends it's jewellery. It sort of is.

lingerie.label: Champagne Lace Lingerie
lingerie.text: Champagne-coloured lace, more air than fabric. It came in a box with a ribbon, and the ribbon was the least of it.

plush_cuffs.label: Plush Handcuffs
plush_cuffs.text: Pink fluffy handcuffs with a tiny key. The fluff is for comfort. The key, Totò says, is optional.

eden_wave.label: Vibrator “Eden Wave”
eden_wave.text: Smooth, quiet, waterproof, in Eden blue with a tiny gold anchor. Nobody at the Eden Group will admit who signed off on the merchandise.

jeweled_plug.label: Jewelled Butt Plug
jeweled_plug.text: Polished steel with a sparkling pink stone on the end. Totò holds the box at arm's length and says, “Very elegant. Very discreet.” It is neither.

flamenco_dessous.label: Ruffled Lingerie
flamenco_dessous.text: Red and black, with ruffles that move like a skirt in the wind. It isn't for sale to just anyone.

chiara_tasse.label: A Cup Just for Her
chiara_tasse.text: A cup painted by hand in Petru's workshop, her name on the side in careful letters. Not a guest cup. Hers.

rosi_schild.label: Workshop Sign “Scuderi & Figlie”
rosi_schild.text: Driftwood, carved letters: “Scuderi & Figlie”. A sign for a workshop that doesn't exist yet. Petru carved it as if it already does.
rosi_schild.wirkung_text: For the workshop she wants to have one day.

sophia_fueller.label: A Pen with Her Own Name
sophia_fueller.text: A pen engraved with Sophia Moore, and no other name. For the first thing she writes that is hers.

lea_tauchcomputer.label: Dive Computer
lea_tauchcomputer.text: A dive computer, tested and set to her depths. For the dives she plans herself, and comes back from.

siri_ratgeber.label: Guide: The Art of Fishing in Corsica
siri_ratgeber.text: Petru's stories about fishing the Corsican coast, bound by hand in linen. A book for a father who used to take his daughter out on the water.

lola_vegemite.label: A Jar of Vegemite
lola_vegemite.text: A jar of black-brown spread from Alva's secret stash. The rest of Europe calls it a mistake. Some people call it home.

alva_kastagnetten.label: Her Grandmother's Castanets
alva_kastagnetten.text: Her grandmother's castanets from Sevilla, broken for years, mended by Petru so they click again. Some things wait a long time to be played.

megan_crewkarte.label: A Card Signed by the Whole Crew
megan_crewkarte.text: A card in a plain frame, signed by every single person on the boat. You can buy a yacht. You can't buy this.

holm_lakritz.label: A Tin of Norwegian Salt Liquorice
holm_lakritz.text: A tin of Norwegian salt liquorice, black and fierce. Most people spit it out. The people who don't are usually from very cold places.

toto_gennaro.label: San Gennaro Figurine from Naples
toto_gennaro.text: A painted plaster San Gennaro from a stall in Naples, a little chipped at the halo. Every Neapolitan kitchen has one watching over the coffee.

yasin_goldbrille.label: Gold Sunglasses “Monaco”
yasin_goldbrille.text: Gold-framed sunglasses with “Monaco” on the arm in tiny letters. They make any face look like it owns a boat, which is the point.

elsa_strafzettelblock.label: Leather-Bound Ticket Book
elsa_strafzettelblock.text: A ticket book bound in leather, her initials pressed into the cover. Finally, something worthy of her handwriting.

petru_tabak.label: Pipe Tobacco “Bastia Noir”
petru_tabak.text: Dark pipe tobacco from Bastia, the kind they stopped selling in the village years ago. It smells of a wheelhouse at night.

casanova_kanone.label: Confetti Cannon
casanova_kanone.text: A confetti cannon as big as a small car, with a crank. Officially for the Festa. Unofficially, it will be pointed at the yacht.

petrus_hammer.label: Petru's Little Hammer
petrus_hammer.text: A small hammer with a handle worn dark by one man's grip. Petru fixes boats with it. Lent to you, it feels like a vote of confidence.

leas_taucherbrille.label: Lea's Old Dive Mask
leas_taucherbrille.text: An old dive mask with a cracked strap, mended with tape. Lea saw her first reef through it. She swears it still remembers the way.

elsas_taschenlampe.label: Elsa's Service Torch
elsas_taschenlampe.text: A heavy black service torch from the Gendarmerie Maritime. It has found smugglers, lost dogs and one very embarrassed mayor.

rosis_handschuhe.label: Rosi's Workshop Gloves
rosis_handschuhe.text: Leather workshop gloves, oil-black, a hole in the left thumb. Rosi says the hole is a design feature.

totos_notizbuch.label: Totò's Notebook of Prices
totos_notizbuch.text: A greasy little notebook full of prices, nicknames and debts in Totò's code. Half of the island is in here. Some of them owe him a goat.

siris_halstuch.label: Siri's Silk Neckerchief
siris_halstuch.text: A silk neckerchief, sea-blue, that still smells faintly of her perfume. She wore it on a shoot once and said it was the only real thing in the picture.

megans_manschetten.label: Megan's Cufflinks
megans_manschetten.text: Black onyx cufflinks with a small golden anchor. Fleet issue for directors only. Megan doesn't give them away. She lends them, which is worse.

lolas_band.label: Lola's Friendship Bracelet
lolas_band.text: A woven friendship bracelet in all the colours of the galley. Lola made two. She's wearing the other one.

sophias_lesezeichen.label: Sophia's Bookmark
sophias_lesezeichen.text: A thin silver bookmark, cool to the touch, slipped between two pages for you to find. She marked the place where she stopped reading. Or started.

lockpicks.label: Totò's “Emergency” Lock Picks
lockpicks.text: A slim leather wallet of picks and tension wrenches. Totò says they're for “emergencies”. He has a lot of emergencies.
lockpicks.wirkung_text: Once a day, advantage on Cunning.

binoculars.label: Harbour Watcher's Binoculars
binoculars.text: Heavy naval binoculars with a cracked leather strap. Someone in the village watched every ship come and go through these for thirty years.
binoculars.wirkung_text: Once a day, advantage on Perception.

petrus_messer.label: Petru's Old Fishing Knife
petrus_messer.text: Petru's old fishing knife, the blade thin from sharpening. It has gutted more fish than you'll eat in your life. He gave it without looking up.
petrus_messer.wirkung_text: Once a day, advantage on Perception.

aftershave.label: Aftershave “Bastia”
aftershave.text: Aftershave “Bastia”: cedar, lime and the confidence of a man with a gold tooth. Alva sells it to sailors who want to be remembered.
aftershave.wirkung_text: Once a day, advantage on Charm.

plektrum.label: Lola's Plectrum
plektrum.text: A purple plectrum with a tiny bite mark. Lola plays with it when she thinks nobody is listening. Everybody is listening.
plektrum.wirkung_text: Once a day, advantage on Charm.

megan_screenshot.label: Wrong Chat
megan_screenshot.text: She says it was a mistake. Megan McAllister doesn't make mistakes.
megan_screenshot.wirkung_text: Once a day: advantage on Charm with Megan.

lucky_coin.label: Old Ten-Franc Lucky Coin
lucky_coin.text: An old ten-franc coin, worn smooth on one side. Alva's father kept it in the till for forty years. She doesn't say why she's giving it to you.
lucky_coin.wirkung_text: Once a day, advantage on Courage.

elsas_abzeichen.label: Badge of the Gendarmerie Maritime
elsas_abzeichen.text: The badge of the Gendarmerie Maritime, enamel chipped at one corner. People stand differently when they see it. So, it turns out, do you.
elsas_abzeichen.wirkung_text: Once a day, advantage on Courage.

dumenica_amulet.label: Dumenica's Amulet
dumenica_amulet.text: A little silver hand on a black cord. Mazzere wear it so they wake up from the hunt.
dumenica_amulet.wirkung_text: Once a day, advantage on Perception.

legion_kepi.label: Wolff's Képi
legion_kepi.text: A white képi with a frayed band. People stand up straighter when they see it.
legion_kepi.wirkung_text: Once a day, advantage on Courage.

tarot.label: Tarot Deck with a Missing Card
tarot.text: A worn deck of tarot cards, the edges soft as cloth. One card is missing. Whoever took it knew exactly which one.
tarot.wirkung_text: Once a day, advantage on Empathy.

netzknoten.label: Petru's Net Knot
netzknoten.text: A single knot cut out of one of Petru's nets, tight and neat as a heartbeat. He says a good knot holds without being pulled.
netzknoten.wirkung_text: Once a day, advantage on Empathy.

diesel_canister.label: Can of Diesel
diesel_canister.text: A red jerry can, dented, smelling of the harbour. Alva's is dearer than Totò's. Alva's also didn't fall off anything.
diesel_canister.wirkung_text: At Alva's, one can a day at most, and dearer than at Totò's.

used_battery.label: Spiteful Used Boat Battery
used_battery.text: Scratched, dented, still holding a charge. Mostly out of spite.

panel_cleaner.label: Solar Panel Cleaner
panel_cleaner.text: A spray bottle of solar panel cleaner and a squeegee. Glamorous it isn't. Neither is a dead battery at two in the morning.

ersatzteilkiste.label: Box of Unsorted Spare Parts
ersatzteilkiste.text: A box of screws, seals and cable lugs, sorted by nobody. To most people it's junk. To Rosi it's Christmas.

espresso.label: Double Espresso
espresso.text: A double espresso in a paper cup, strong enough to restart a heart. Your hands will thank you later. Not now.
espresso.wirkung_text: In a fight: +3 stamina, but your hands shake: parry window −10 % this round. Quick: costs no turn.

energieriegel.label: Lola's Energy Bar
energieriegel.text: Oats, dates, honey and a pinch of salt, wrapped in baking paper with a smiley drawn on it. Lola makes a batch every Monday.

lolas_pesto.label: Lola's “Special Pesto”
lolas_pesto.text: A jar of very green pesto with a handwritten label: “SPECIAL”. Lola winks when she hands it over. Do not ask what makes it special.

frischer_fang.label: Fresh Catch
frischer_fang.text: Today's catch on a bed of ice, eyes still bright. It was in the sea this morning. By tonight, it'll be dinner.

kuehlakkus.label: Ice Packs from the Village
kuehlakkus.text: Blue ice packs from the village shop. In a heatwave with no power, they are worth more than gold. Gold doesn't keep the butter cold.
kuehlakkus.wirkung_text: The supplies last a day longer when power runs low.

rose_festa.label: The Mayor's Rose
rose_festa.text: A red rose from Madame Casanova's hair, thrown after the flamenco. Every woman on the boat saw where it landed.
rose_festa.wirkung_text: Used once: Desire +6 with every woman.

ersatzzellen.label: “Probably Fine” Spare Cells
ersatzzellen.text: Two used lithium cells, tested, labelled in marker: “PROBABLY FINE”. That's Totò's highest grade of quality.

kommentar.text: Cells for Rosi? Tell her they come from a very honest boat. Mostly honest.

relais.label: Compressor Relay
relais.text: A compressor relay the size of a matchbox. Without it, the cold room is just a room. With it, the crew eats tomorrow.

kommentar.text: The relay for Alva. I knew somebody would need it one day. That's why I had it.

messingbuchstaben.label: Brass Letters
messingbuchstaben.text: A handful of brass letters, polished by Totò's sleeve. Enough to spell a name, if you choose carefully.

kommentar.text: Brass letters. I have three R's and far too many S's. Spell carefully, Comandante.

holzleim.label: Old-School Bone Glue
holzleim.text: A pot of bone glue, the old kind that has to be warmed. It smells terrible. It holds forever. Petru won't use anything else.

kommentar.text: Glue. The one thing even I can't steal - it sticks to the fingers.

eichenbrett.label: Oak Board from a Lost Door
eichenbrett.text: An old oak board, dark with age, from a door that no longer exists. Alva had it in the back room. She said it was too good to burn.

kommentar.text: Oak from the old church pews. Don't tell the priest, o figliolu. He'll want it back.

tonerde.label: Riverbank Clay
tonerde.text: A sack of grey clay from the riverbank. Cold, heavy, and ready to become anything, if someone patient gets their hands on it.

kommentar.text: Clay for Petru's wheel? He'll grumble and love it. Like everything.

uhrenbatterie.label: Button Cell
uhrenbatterie.text: A button cell for a watch, sealed in plastic you can't open without a knife and swearing.

kommentar.text: A battery this small and you look so serious. Who is it for? Don't tell me. I'll find out anyway.

goldfarbe.label: Gold Paint and a Fine Brush
goldfarbe.text: A little tin of gold paint and a brush with three hairs. For the details nobody notices until they're missing.

kommentar.text: Gold paint. Either you're painting a saint, or you've fallen for a pirate.

safran.label: Real Saffron
safran.text: A few threads of real saffron in a twist of paper, worth more than their weight in silver. Alva keeps it in the till, not the kitchen.

kommentar.text: Real saffron from Sardinia. Costs more than gold, smells better. Tell Lola to be gentle with it.

buchbinde_leinen.label: Bookbinding Linen
buchbinde_leinen.text: A roll of bookbinding linen in faded blue. Stories need covers, too, or they fall apart.

kommentar.text: Bookbinding linen. Somebody is making something to keep. Good. We need more of that.

netzgarn.label: Roll of Net Twine
netzgarn.text: A roll of tarred net twine. Every fisherman in the bay has mended a net with this, and every one of them has a theory about the right knot.

kommentar.text: Net yarn for Petru. He'll never say thank you. He'll just mend faster.

bilderrahmen.label: A Simple Picture Frame
bilderrahmen.text: A plain wooden frame, nothing fancy. It doesn't need to be. What goes inside is the point.

kommentar.text: A frame. For what, a wanted poster? ...Oh. That's sweet. Don't tell anyone I said sweet.

armband.label: Silicone Strap from Livorno
armband.text: A silicone strap, fleet grey. Totò says it fell off a container in Livorno. Very gently.

kommentar.text: A silicone strap. It fell off a container in Livorno. Very gently, Comandante.

fueller_rohling.label: Pen Blank for Engraving
fueller_rohling.text: A pen blank, smooth, waiting to be engraved. Right now it's nobody's pen. Soon it'll be somebody's.

kommentar.text: A pen blank? Somebody's going to write love letters. Don't look at me like that, I sell everything.

antennenkabel.label: Antenna Cable, Seawater-Proof
antennenkabel.text: Seawater-proof antenna cable, a whole coil. Officially for the gendarmerie. Unofficially, don't ask Totò where he got it.

kommentar.text: Seawater-proof cable for the gendarmerie. Beautiful. Just don't tell Elsa where it came from.

werkzeugkoffer.label: Battered Red Toolbox
werkzeugkoffer.text: A battered red toolbox with a dent in the lid and everything in its place. Someone loved these tools before you did.
werkzeugkoffer.wirkung_text: Advantage on repair jobs (or +2 if your craft already gives advantage).

kochmesser.label: Japanese Chef's Knife
kochmesser.text: A Japanese chef's knife, the steel folded until it shows a pattern like water. It doesn't cut so much as agree with the onion.
kochmesser.wirkung_text: Advantage on cooking jobs (or +2 if your cooking already gives advantage).

plaster.label: Dolphin Plasters
plaster.text: A box of plasters with cartoon dolphins on them. They work just as well as the boring ones, and they look better on a hero.
plaster.wirkung_text: In a fight: heals 10 % of your HP and stops bleeding. Quick: costs no turn.

bandage.label: Bandage
bandage.text: A rolled bandage, still sealed. Every boat has a drawer of these. Every captain hopes they stay in it.
bandage.wirkung_text: In a fight: heals 25 % of your HP and stops bleeding.

verbandskasten.label: “USE ME” First Aid Kit
verbandskasten.text: A green first aid kit with the Eden anchor on the lid. Somebody has written “USE ME” on it in red marker. Somebody has clearly needed to.
verbandskasten.wirkung_text: In a fight: heals 40 % of your HP and stops bleeding and burning.

cooling_spray.label: Cooling Spray
cooling_spray.text: A can of cooling spray meant for sprained ankles. Turns out it does wonders for being on fire.
cooling_spray.wirkung_text: In a fight: puts out every flame on you, and you can't catch fire for 2 rounds. Quick: costs no turn.

smoke_pot.label: Lifeboat Smoke Pot
smoke_pot.text: A tin smoke pot, the kind used to signal from lifeboats. Pull the ring and the world turns grey for a while.
smoke_pot.wirkung_text: In a fight: their next attack hits only smoke, and next turn you can run without a roll (not from bosses).

antidote.label: Monastery Herbal Tincture
antidote.text: A dark tincture in a corked bottle from the monastery pharmacy. Bitter enough to make your eyes water. That's how you know it works.
antidote.wirkung_text: In a fight: ends every bad state on you.

espresso_single.label: Espresso
espresso_single.text: A single espresso. Small, black, and deeply judgemental.
espresso_single.wirkung_text: In a fight: +2 stamina. Quick: costs no turn.

americano.label: Americano
americano.text: An espresso with water added, which any Italian on board will tell you is a crime. Still, it keeps you going.
americano.wirkung_text: In a fight: +1 stamina every round for 4 rounds. Quick: costs no turn.

mate.label: Mate
mate.text: Mate in a gourd with a metal straw. Bitter, grassy, and it clears your head faster than a slap.
mate.wirkung_text: In a fight: clears your head of stun and blindness, +1 stamina.

green_tea.label: Green Tea
green_tea.text: A cup of green tea, steam curling. It doesn't make you faster. It makes everything else slower.
green_tea.wirkung_text: In a fight: parry window +15 % for 3 rounds. Quick: costs no turn.

dog_food.label: Happy Labrador Dog Food
dog_food.text: A tin of dog food with a picture of a very happy labrador. Hungry animals take the deal more often than you'd think.
dog_food.wirkung_text: In a fight, thrown at an animal: it eats instead of biting, skips a round and loses 4 composure.

megaphone.label: Eden Motivation Megaphone
megaphone.text: A white megaphone with the Eden logo. Megan's office sends them out for “crew motivation”. Nobody knows if that's a joke.
megaphone.wirkung_text: In a fight: a human loses 5 composure, an animal is exhausted for 2 rounds.

duct_tape.label: Duct Tape
duct_tape.text: A roll of silver duct tape. It has held together boats, marriages and at least one rescue helicopter.
duct_tape.wirkung_text: In a fight: you patch your jacket, protection +2 for the rest of the fight.

whetstone_blue.label: Blue Whetstone
whetstone_blue.text: A blue whetstone, wet and smooth. Rosi cut it to fit a sabre. Draw the blade across it slowly, and it starts to sing.
whetstone_blue.wirkung_text: For sabres: +3 damage for 5 rounds. Use it before a fight or during one.

whetstone.label: Grey Whetstone
whetstone.text: A grey whetstone, small enough for a pocket. For knives that should stay quiet and sharp.
whetstone.wirkung_text: For knives: +3 damage for 5 rounds. Use it before a fight or during one.

whetstone_red.label: Red Whetstone
whetstone_red.text: A red whetstone, heavy and coarse, cut for a boar spear. Every stroke takes off a little rust and a little doubt.
whetstone_red.wirkung_text: For the boar spear: +3 damage for 5 rounds. Use it before a fight or during one.

spikes.label: Persuasion Spikes
spikes.text: Steel spikes that strap onto anything blunt. Rosi calls it “persuasion hardware”.
spikes.wirkung_text: For blunt weapons: +3 damage for 5 rounds. Use it before a fight or during one.

match_ammo.label: Hand-Loaded Match Ammo
match_ammo.text: Hand-loaded match ammunition, every cartridge weighed. Rosi doesn't trust factory rounds. Rosi doesn't trust factories.
match_ammo.wirkung_text: For the rifle: +3 damage for 5 rounds. Use it before a fight or during one.

grenade_fire.label: Rosi's Fire Grenade
grenade_fire.text: One of Rosi's home-made grenades, warm to the touch for no good reason. The label says DO NOT SHAKE. It has been shaken.
grenade_fire.wirkung_text: In a fight: 12 % of the enemy's HP straight through armour, and it burns (2 stacks).

grenade_water.label: Rosi's Water Grenade
grenade_water.text: Rosi filled it from an old fire extinguisher and a lot of optimism. It's wet. Spectacularly wet.
grenade_water.wirkung_text: In a fight: 12 % of the enemy's HP straight through armour, and it's wet.

grenade_shock.label: Rosi's Shock Grenade
grenade_shock.text: Two battery cells and a lot of tape. Rosi says it's perfectly safe. Rosi also lost her eyebrows once.
grenade_shock.wirkung_text: In a fight: 12 % of the enemy's HP straight through armour, and it's charged. On a wet enemy: short circuit.

grenade_flash.label: Rosi's Flash Grenade
grenade_flash.text: No damage, just light. For one long second, everything goes white and very quiet.
grenade_flash.wirkung_text: No damage, just light. In a fight: the enemy is blinded for a round and its next blow does half damage.

grenade_sleep.label: Rosi's Sleep Grenade
grenade_sleep.text: Bibi asked for something that doesn't kill them. Rosi laughed, then built it. The blue tape is so nobody throws it at a person. Rosi says that happened only once.

grenade_concussion.label: Rosi's Concussion Grenade
grenade_concussion.text: Heavy, and it means it. Rosi drew a little smiley face on it, which is somehow worse.
grenade_concussion.wirkung_text: In a fight: 12 % of the enemy's HP straight through armour, and it's shaken (armour gone).

grenade_shrapnel.label: Rosi's Shrapnel Grenade
grenade_shrapnel.text: Packed with boat nails from Rosi's workshop. Useless against machines. Not useless against anything else.
grenade_shrapnel.wirkung_text: In a fight: 18 % of the enemy's HP straight through armour, and it bleeds. Useless against machines.

steel_plate.label: Steel Plate
steel_plate.text: A plain steel plate, heavy and honest. Rosi taps it twice, listens, and nods like a doctor.
steel_plate.wirkung_text: A steel plate for Rosi's workshop: the first upgrade for a jacket or Gemelli.

titanium_plate.label: Titanium Plate
titanium_plate.text: Black titanium, light for its strength, blue at the edges. Taken from something that was built to win.
titanium_plate.wirkung_text: A titanium plate for Rosi's workshop: the second upgrade for a jacket or Gemelli.

jade.label: Jade
jade.text: A smooth green jade, cool in the hand. Rosi says stone remembers the ground it came from.
jade.wirkung_text: A stone for Rosi: it replaces Terremoto's base stone (first upgrade).

topas.label: Topaz
topas.text: A golden topaz, warm as late sun. It looks like it's been holding a little light all this time.
topas.wirkung_text: A stone for Rosi: it replaces Le Large's base stone (first upgrade).

aquamarin.label: Aquamarine
aquamarin.text: A pale aquamarine, the colour of the bay at seven in the morning, before the boats come out.
aquamarin.wirkung_text: A stone for Rosi: it replaces Riposte's base stone (first upgrade).

amethyst.label: Amethyst
amethyst.text: A violet amethyst. Sailors once wore them against drunkenness. It didn't work, but they kept wearing them.
amethyst.wirkung_text: A stone for Rosi: it replaces Sussurro's base stone (first upgrade).

smaragd.label: Emerald
smaragd.text: A deep green emerald, flawed inside like a forest. Rosi won't cut it. She says the flaw is where the strength is.
smaragd.wirkung_text: A precious stone for Rosi: Terremoto's final stone (second upgrade).

rubin.label: Ruby
rubin.text: A blood-red ruby. It glows even in the dark of the workshop, as if it were still deciding something.
rubin.wirkung_text: A precious stone for Rosi: Le Large's final stone (second upgrade).

saphir.label: Sapphire
saphir.text: A royal blue sapphire, cold and certain. The kind of stone that ends arguments.
saphir.wirkung_text: A precious stone for Rosi: Riposte's final stone (second upgrade).

opal.label: Opal
opal.text: A white opal full of small fires, blue, green and pink. Turn it in the light and it never shows the same thing twice.
opal.wirkung_text: A precious stone for Rosi: Sussurro's final stone (second upgrade).

kupfer.label: Copper
kupfer.text: A copper ingot, orange-red and shiny as a new coin. Rosi polished it with her sleeve. Then she polished it again.
kupfer.wirkung_text: A copper ingot for Rosi: the first upgrade for Gemelli.

silber.label: Silver
silber.text: A silver ingot, warm white and heavy. Pure enough that Rosi took off her gloves to hold it.
silber.wirkung_text: A silver ingot for Rosi: the second upgrade for Gemelli.

alvas_schluessel.label: Key to Alva's Back Room
alvas_schluessel.text: A small brass key on a red ribbon. The back room of Alva's bar has a sofa, a record player and a lock that very few people have seen from the inside.

sat_data.label: “Internet from the Sky” Data Package
sat_data.text: A sealed satellite data package with a serial number filed off. Totò calls it “internet from the sky”. The sky did not agree to this.

cuban_rum.label: Unstamped Cuban Rum
cuban_rum.text: Dark rum with a hand-written label and no tax stamp anywhere. It tastes of molasses, wood and very bad decisions made in very good company.

cigars.label: Cohiba Cigars
cigars.text: A box of Cohibas, the seal unbroken. The old men at the harbour would sell their grandmothers for one. Some have tried.
cigars.wirkung_text: Village Reputation +2 with the old men at the harbour

limoncello_kiste.label: Crate of Limoncello without a Tax Stamp
limoncello_kiste.text: Twelve bottles of limoncello, no tax stamp, a crate marked “OLIVES”. The olives are very convincing. Mostly yellow.

taschen.label: Three “Designer” Handbags
taschen.text: Three “designer” handbags, each logo slightly misspelt. From a distance, perfect. From close up, a lot of character.

muschelkrone.label: Shell Crown of the Festa
muschelkrone.text: A crown of shells, glitter and hot glue from the Festa. Glitter, shells and dignity, in that order.

echo.text: You have to! You'd be a prince! A shell prince! I'll carry your train!

rosis_foto.label: A Photo You Shouldn't Delete
rosis_foto.text: A photo you were told to delete. Rosi knows you didn't. She hasn't asked. That's the interesting part.

echo.text: Okay. Okay. Then this one's on purpose. Don't show Totò.

siris_karte.label: Siri's Thank-You Card
siris_karte.text: A small card in neat handwriting: “Thank you for my first birthday without a camera.”

echo.text: Thank you for my first birthday without a camera. I mean it. Don't make it weird.

holms_foto.label: Photo of Holm's First Command
holms_foto.text: A rusty freighter off Bergen, a young woman in a cap squinting at the camera. Holm's first command, and she looks like she already knew.

echo.text: Then one night I said, I don't know, let's find out together. After that they listened. Funny, hm?

siris_haarband.label: Siri's Hairband
siris_haarband.text: A hairband she tucked into your hair while you were dancing. She laughed when it slipped over one eye. You kept it.

echo.text: Left, left, turn, shoulder. Rosi, the other left. No, the other other left.

drohnen_propeller.label: Propeller from Megan's Drone
drohnen_propeller.text: A carbon propeller from Megan's surveillance drone. A trophy. Megan wants it back. Never.

echo.text: Impressive. Give that girl a raise, but not a big one.

ambrosius_keule.label: Brother Ambrosius' Golden Mace
ambrosius_keule.text: The abbot's golden mace with an ivory grip. Frederico hid it until someone good came.

diary_page_1.label: Brother Ambrosius' Diary, Page 1
diary_page_1.text: “The animals don't flee from us. They flee from something inside themselves.”

diary_page_2.label: Brother Ambrosius' Diary, Page 2
diary_page_2.text: “I have seen the lion. He wears something on his neck that blinks. He suffers, as we do.”

agent_note.label: Torn Note
agent_note.text: A torn note, written to sound greedy. On the back, in pencil, someone has sketched the collar of a jacket with far more care than the note itself.

tritons_dreizack.label: Triton's Trident (Siren Drop)
tritons_dreizack.text: A trident of green bronze, crusted with tiny shells, cold even in the sun. It rose from the black pool at high tide. Nobody saw who let go of it.

fairy_bread.label: Fairy Bread
fairy_bread.text: White toast, butter, and hundreds and thousands of sprinkles. In Australia it means a children's birthday. On this boat it means someone needs cheering up.

lamingtons.label: Lamingtons
lamingtons.text: Squares of sponge cake dipped in chocolate and rolled in coconut. Lola makes them in the exact size of a bad day.

pavlova.label: Pavlova with Figs and Myrtle
pavlova.text: A cloud of meringue with cream, fresh figs and a drizzle of myrtle syrup. Australia and Corsica on one plate, and neither of them is complaining.

anzac.label: Anzac Biscuits
anzac.text: Oat and golden syrup biscuits that keep for weeks. Soldiers' wives once baked them because they survived the long voyage. Night watches love them for the same reason.

vegemite_schnecken.label: Vegemite Cheese Scrolls
vegemite_schnecken.text: Soft pastry scrolls with cheese and a thin swirl of Vegemite. The Corsicans eye them with suspicion. Then they take a second one.

tim_tam_slam.label: Tim Tam Slam Set
tim_tam_slam.text: Two chocolate biscuits and a mug of hot cocoa. Bite off the corners, suck the cocoa through, eat fast before it collapses. It always collapses.

ocean_popcorn.label: Ocean Glitter Popcorn
ocean_popcorn.text: Popcorn tossed in Lola's Ocean Glitter spice. It sparkles, it crackles, and it sticks to your fingers like confetti after a parade.

kevins_rache.label: Kevin's Revenge
kevins_rache.text: Shortbread biscuits cut in the shape of seagulls. Bite the heads off first. Kevin is watching. Kevin knows.

rote_gruetze.label: Red Berry Pudding with Vanilla Sauce
rote_gruetze.text: Red berry pudding with cold vanilla sauce, the way they make it up north. Lola learned it from a cookbook and a long phone call.

madeleines.label: Lavender Madeleines
madeleines.text: Little shell-shaped cakes with a hint of lavender. Best eaten warm, with tea, and with someone who doesn't need to talk.

cannoli.label: Cannoli with a Spanner Biscuit
cannoli.text: Crisp Sicilian pastry tubes filled with ricotta, served with a biscuit shaped like a spanner. Lola thinks this is a joke. It is, a little.

plankton_gelee.label: Glowing Plankton Jelly
plankton_gelee.text: A jelly that glows a faint blue in the dark, thanks to tonic water and science. Lola calls it plankton. It is not plankton. Probably.

seegras_chips.label: Seaweed Crisps with Lime
seegras_chips.text: Crispy seaweed with lime and sea salt, thin as paper. They taste like the first swim of the morning.

protein_pancakes.label: Protein Pancakes, No Fun Included
protein_pancakes.text: Protein pancakes, no sugar, no butter, no fun included. Lola made them under protest and drew a sad face in the syrup.

ghost_brownies.label: Ghost Pepper Brownies
ghost_brownies.text: Dark chocolate brownies with ghost pepper. The first bite is heaven. The second bite is a war crime.

fiadone.label: Fiadone
fiadone.text: Corsican cheesecake made with brocciu and lemon zest, the recipe older than anyone in the village. Lola had to beg for it.

tiramisu_martini.label: Espresso Martini Tiramisu
tiramisu_martini.text: Tiramisu in a cocktail glass, soaked in espresso and coffee liqueur. Dessert and nightcap in one, for people who can't decide.

unit01_muffins.label: Unit-01 Muffins
unit01_muffins.text: Pitch-black muffins with a round orange eye of icing. They look like the generator. They taste of vanilla. Unit-01 has not commented.

mango_sorbet.label: Mango Chilli Sorbet
mango_sorbet.text: Mango sorbet with a slow burn of chilli. Sweet first, then trouble. Lola serves it with a wink and a glass of water.

space_cake.label: Space Cake “Universe Edition”
space_cake.text: A slice of cake with dark blue icing and edible stars. The “Universe Edition”. Lola says to eat it slowly and look at the sky afterwards. Trust her.

brownie_calm.label: Brownie “Captain's Calm”
brownie_calm.text: A brownie called “Captain's Calm”. Very soft, very chocolate, and very, very relaxing. Do not operate heavy machinery. Or yachts.

toastie.label: Midnight Toastie with Cheese and Fig
toastie.text: A midnight toastie with melted cheese and fig jam, cut into triangles, because triangles taste better. Everyone knows that.

bun_rieu.label: Bún Riêu
bun_rieu.text: Vietnamese noodle soup with crab, tomato and a red, slightly sour broth. A dish from a street stall in Hanoi, carried across the world in someone's memory.

thit_kho.label: Thịt Kho
thit_kho.text: Pork belly braised in caramel and fish sauce until it falls apart, with eggs and rice. Families in Vietnam make it for the New Year and eat it for days.

bibimbap.label: Bibimbap
bibimbap.text: Rice, vegetables, beef and a fried egg in a hot stone bowl, mixed at the table. Petru looked at it for a long time and asked why it's in a bowl.

summer_rolls.label: Summer Rolls
summer_rolls.text: Rice paper rolls with prawns, mint and lettuce, almost see-through. Light enough to eat on a hot deck. Dangerous with peanut sauce.

ramen.label: Ramen
ramen.text: A broth that simmered for hours, noodles, a soft egg and a slice of pork. Good ramen is patience you can drink.

chili_noodles.label: Chilli Noodles
chili_noodles.text: Wok noodles with chilli oil and spring onions, hot enough to make your nose run. Not for the seasick. Not for the faint of heart either.

bouillabaisse.label: Bouillabaisse
bouillabaisse.text: Provençal fish stew with saffron, rouille and toasted bread. The fishermen of Marseille made it from the fish they couldn't sell. Now it's the most expensive thing on the menu.

bao_buns.label: Bao Buns
bao_buns.text: Soft steamed buns with glazed pork belly, cucumber and coriander. Fluffy as clouds. Gone in two bites.

fish_pie.label: Fish Pie
fish_pie.text: White fish and prawns under a golden crust of mashed potato. Someone in the village made it every Sunday for years. Nobody makes it quite like that anymore.

bolognese.label: Spaghetti Bolognese
bolognese.text: Spaghetti with a long-simmered meat sauce. Totò says that in Naples this is a crime. He eats two plates anyway.

pytt_i_panna.label: Pyttipanne
pytt_i_panna.text: Diced potatoes, sausage and onion fried in one pan, with a fried egg and beetroot. Scandinavian comfort food, best eaten after a cold watch.

fiskesuppe.label: Fiskesuppe
fiskesuppe.text: Norwegian fish soup with salmon, cream and dill. It tastes of a harbour in the rain and a kitchen that's warm.

lauchsuppe.label: Cullen Skink
lauchsuppe.text: Cullen Skink: smoked haddock, potatoes and milk, the Scottish way. A fisherman's soup from a cold coast, gentle on the stomach.

baguettes.label: Baguettes
baguettes.text: Fresh baguettes, crust that shatters, crumb that sighs. Bread is the hardest discipline. Everything else is just cooking.

control_chip.label: Control Chip
control_chip.text: A small black chip, grown into the lion's collar. Engraved: “A.V. Estates – Behaviour Control Unit”.
