laetitia_scarf.label: Laetitia's Red Scarf
laetitia_scarf.text: A faded red scarf, still damp from the lake. It smells of woodsmoke and of a girl who left in a hurry.

av_radio.label: A.V. Estates Radio
av_radio.text: A black field radio with a small white logo: A.V. Estates. The last channel used is still set.

ir_controller.label: Collar Controller
ir_controller.text: A grey handset with an infrared lamp and a dial. Every blinking collar on the mountain answers to it.

ghjuvan_knife.label: Ghjuvan's Father's Knife
ghjuvan_knife.text: A shepherd's knife with a horn handle worn smooth by three generations of the same thumb.

foreign_part.label: The Part That Isn't Ours
foreign_part.text: A small black module, warm to the touch, with a stamped code and a tiny white logo. Rosi pulled it out of Unit-01's control board. It doesn't belong to anything on this boat.

gennaro_drawing.label: Giulia's Drawing
gennaro_drawing.text: A child's drawing of a man with a big moustache in a boat. Underneath, in crooked letters: PAPÀ.

collar_crate.label: The Crate from Antibes
collar_crate.text: A heavy plastic crate with a stamped code and a small white logo. Inside, in foam, forty new collars and a box of control chips. You saw this crate before, in a hangar in Antibes.

ghjacumu_medal.label: Ghjacumu's Medal
ghjacumu_medal.text: A small tin medal of Saint Erasmus, patron of sailors, on a green string. The string has been chewed.

bastien_ring.label: A Ring in a Velvet Box
bastien_ring.text: A ring with a tiny blue stone. The receipt is still in the box. Marseille, March.

treasure_notes.label: Chloé's Notes
treasure_notes.text: A waterproof folder: photos of an old schooner, sonar printouts, and a map of the bay with a red circle on it.

lea_chart_page.label: Page Forty
lea_chart_page.text: A page torn from Lea's chart book: her grandfather's pencil marks, a bay, a cross, and a date from 1924. In the margin, in older pencil: “She sings at the pool when the tide is in.”

babel_badge.label: Employee Badge
babel_badge.text: A staff badge with the logo taped over. Only one word is left to read: BABEL. Whoever taped it did it neatly.

postcard_bibi.label: Postcard from a Zoo
postcard_bibi.text: Giraffes and a French stamp, in big fast handwriting: “I finally went. They have a lion who snores. I'm okay. I think.” No address to write back to.

postcard_charly.label: Postcard from Paris
postcard_charly.text: No sender, postmarked Paris, a very ugly statue on the front. On the back there is only “2/10”. You can't tell if she means the statue.

fish_sauce.label: Fish Sauce
fish_sauce.text: Amber, salty, and a smell that gets into your shirt and stays until Christmas. It comes from a cousin in Marseille, and she won't say which cousin. Everybody says it stinks. Everybody comes back.
fish_sauce.wirkung_text: For cooking, as the flavour: nobody dislikes the dish, whatever is in it.

kl_post.label: Three Weeks of Post
kl_post.text: A bundle of letters in a rubber band, three weeks thick. Mina couldn't get past the bridge. Some of them are for people you still have to find.

old_camel_coat.label: Old Camel Coat
old_camel_coat.text: Heavy camel wool from the thirties, with an English tailor's mark worn nearly smooth. It has been lost at cards at least twice. Both times, someone was very upset.

tofu.label: Tofu
tofu.text: White, firm and pressed this morning at the back of the shop. It tastes of almost nothing until you teach it. Bà Tư says the same about young men.
tofu.wirkung_text: For cooking, as the main. Counts as vegetables.

rice_paper.label: Rice Paper
rice_paper.text: Thin round sheets, dry as old letters. One second in warm water and they bend to anything. Tear one, and you will hear how her mother did it.

rice.label: Rice
rice.text: Long-grain rice from the same cousin in Marseille. Still nobody knows which cousin. She washes it three times and thinks less of you if you wash it twice.

sojasauce.label: Soy Sauce
sojasauce.text: Dark, salty and cheaper here than at the farm. She keeps it on the bottom shelf. The fish sauce gets the top.
sojasauce.wirkung_text: For cooking, as the flavour: sell prices go up for a day.

pho_bowl.label: Bowl from the Pot
pho_bowl.text: Pho from the pot at the back, the one that is never off the fire. She counts every cent, then gives you too much. You eat it here, standing, while she watches.
pho_bowl.wirkung_text: Energy +1. Counts as your meal of the day. Once a day.

lemongrass_cutting.label: Lemongrass Cuttings
lemongrass_cutting.text: Three stalks in damp brown paper, from the pots behind her shop. They want sun, water and a better bed than she has. She knows who has one.

cloth_bolt.label: Bolt of Cloth
cloth_bolt.text: Plain linen that fell off a ferry, according to the man selling it. Danzel doesn't ask which ferry.

corsican_wool.label: Corsican Wool
corsican_wool.text: Sheared on the high pasture and carried down in a sack. It keeps out everything except the smell of sheep.

import_wool.label: Import Wool
import_wool.text: Good Scottish wool at a very bad price. Nobody on this island sells any cheaper now.

duc_cabin.label: Duc's cabin (the only single cabin, door locks)

solar_deck.label: Solar deck (top deck under the panels)

kuehlraum.label: The cold room behind the galley

alvas_terrace.label: Alva's terrace on the harbour (long table, ashore)

siren_pool.label: The pool under the beach grotto (high tide)

anruf_orte.megan: her office at the Eden Group

chiara.name: Chiara Sonnberg
gesten: rates something out loud on a scale of ten
hugs someone in the middle of a sentence
hands somebody a job the moment she feels unsure
orders in proud, slightly wrong Italian

sophia.name: Sophia Moore
gesten: writes something in her small brown leather notebook and never says what
lets a sentence sit in silence
offers a bet when she's cornered
straightens someone's collar

lea.name: Lea Moore
gesten: salutes when she's nervous
sketches a fish on whatever paper is near
drops a sea fact nobody asked for
gets faster when she's nervous and her facts go wrong

rosi.name: Rosi Scuderi
gesten: talks to a machine instead of about herself
shouts an attack name at the torque wrench
wipes oily hands on her trousers
flares up for ten seconds, then is calm again

siri.name: Siri Lindvik
gesten: apologises to a piece of furniture
slips into her bright camera voice, then drops back into her real one
laughs at herself before anyone else can
asks a question nobody would ask Siri Sea

toto.name: Salvatore 'Totò' Esposito
toto.beschreibung: the bosun, 47, from Naples, of African descent; gold chain, flip-flops, always eating something; calls Duc 'Comandante'; a cousin in Bastia who comes by rubber boat at night; sells anything from a locked locker in the lazarette and never asks where things come from - 'Nothing fell off a truck, Comandante. It fell off a boat.' Warm-hearted, funny, loyal to the crew, allergic to paperwork. Runs the betting board in the engine room.
gesten: eats something while he talks
talks with his hands, gold chain swinging
offers odds on anything
jingles the keys of his locked locker
geschenk_reaktion: Toto takes it, appraises it like a fence - weight, value, who would buy it - and is touched anyway, though he would never say so directly.

yasin.name: Yasin Benali
yasin.beschreibung: Siri's boyfriend, 29, from Paris, sells online trading courses; expensive watch, cash for every tip, a phone always filming; flirts with every woman of the crew, calls the crew 'my team', treats Siri like a prop. Stranded, he is furious and bored.
gesten: films everything on his phone
checks his expensive watch
calls something 'content'
says one honest sentence and covers it with a grin
geschenk_reaktion: Yasin takes it, films it immediately and turns the moment into content about himself.

holm.name: Captain Marit Holm
holm.beschreibung: the captain, 52, from Alesund in Norway, eleven seasons on the Eden Rise, a legend of the fleet; dry, fair, impossible to fool, never loud and never says anything twice; wears her father's brass compass and drinks her coffee cold; calls her new First Officer 'Frankfurt' and does not yet take him quite seriously; the crew is her family and she pretends that annoys her; she has had stomach pains all day and waves them away; says 'Takk'
gesten: drinks her coffee black and cold and says nothing
checks something off on a clipboard
says 'Takk' and nothing else
says the important thing exactly once

elsa.name: Elsa Ferrandi
elsa.beschreibung: lieutenant of the maritime gendarmerie, 29, born in Cala d'Orsu into a big loud fishing family - father Ange, mother Marie-Jo with the vegetable stall at the harbour who calls her on duty to ask when she will marry, three big brothers and a Nonna who cooks for fourteen every Sunday; has run the small coast-guard post for five years with two men, a fast patrol boat and an antenna that has waited eleven months for a form; dry humour, sharp eyes, never breaks a rule but bends one for the village; chases Toto like Zenigata chases Lupin ('TOTOOO!'); money is an insult, figs are fine; secretly reads romance novels and cries at Disney films - anyone who tells gets a ticket
gesten: writes it down as if dictating a report
asks for facts, not opinions
taps her pen on her notebook
breaks her calm only to shout for Totò

bestechung.regie: Duc offers her something valuable: %s. That looks like a bribe to a gendarme. She refuses it - sharp or drily amused - hands it back and makes a note of it.

geschenk_reaktion: Elsa accepts the small gift with a dry remark and puts it away, a little amused.

alva.name: Alva Santoni
alva.beschreibung: owner of the only bar in Cala d'Orsu, 35; her Corsican father Ghjuvan ran the bar for forty years, her mother was Andalusian and her grandmother danced flamenco in Seville; at 22 Alva wanted to go to Seville to dance, then her father had a stroke and she came home and stayed; he died three years ago and the old jukebox in the corner has been silent since; knows everything that happens in the village, sells diesel under the counter, flirts with everyone and means it with nobody ('Everybody's welcome. Nobody's mine.'); calls people 'o figliolu' now and then; has not spoken to the mayor for two years
gesten: polishes a glass that is already clean
rests a hand on the old jukebox that has been silent since Papa died
listens longer than she talks, then says the one line that lands
slides a drink across the bar unasked
geschenk_reaktion: Alva takes it with a knowing grin and a teasing remark; by tomorrow the whole village will know.

petru.name: Petru Albertini
petru.beschreibung: old fisherman in his seventies with his own boat workshop at the harbour; his wife Marie died five years ago and since then he mends nets that are not broken; says almost nothing - his 'Hm.' has ten meanings - and repairs everything for everyone without taking money, only fish and company; a radio on the workbench always plays Corsican football; his daughter Laetitia always wanted to leave and he never told her he needs her; knows every legend of the coast - his grandfather rowed out in 1924 when the village saved the crew of the Margot; 'The sea doesn't hurry.'
gesten: mends a net that isn't torn
says 'Hm.' and lets it mean something
nods once - that is praise
turns the radio a little louder instead of answering
geschenk_reaktion: Petru turns it over in his hands, says almost nothing, and nods once. For him that is a lot.

casanova.name: Madame Casanova
casanova.beschreibung: mayor of Cala d'Orsu, 40, daughter of the old mayor; a whirlwind with anime-style humour - dramatic poses, exaggerated gasps, fist pumps, a confetti cannon and sudden speeches; organises every village feast like the Olympics and treats it like a season finale ('THIS. IS. THE. FESTA!'); the villa on the hill was her parents' house until her father had to sell it; loud because she carries a guilt she never mentions; has not spoken to Alva for two years; wants the stranded superyacht as the big attraction of the festa
geschenk_reaktion: The mayor reacts as if she had been given a national honour - gasps, poses, a little speech.

lola.name: Lola Brennan
lola.beschreibung: the yacht's cook, 24, a backpacker from Byron Bay, Australia, who signed on in Antibes because the old chef quit and she was 'literally standing right there'; scatterbrained, warm, without malice, often a little drunk or a little high and mostly happy; loses her phone three times a day; in the galley she is focused, fast and wildly creative and never cooks the same dish twice; strong Aussie slang ('mate', 'heaps', 'reckon', 'no worries'), starts sentences and forgets the end; calls Duc 'Boss'; loves gossip because people are 'just so interesting', so whatever she hears, the whole boat knows by dinner; Toto sells her 'herbs', she is Rosi's partner in crime at night, Chiara despairs of her hygiene; once she worked in a star restaurant in Sydney where the head chef shouted every night and told her she would never be more than a line cook - she walked out that night and drifted the other way, barefoot, no recipes, free; under stress 'Yes, Chef!' still slips out and she laughs it off; dreams of a little beach kitchen with no head chef; wants to hear that she is good
gesten: talks with her hands and her wooden spoon
starts a sentence and loses the end of it
laughs at her own joke before anyone else does
pads around barefoot, tasting something off a spoon

megan.name: Megan McAllister
megan.beschreibung: Fleet Director of the Eden Group, 38, from Edinburgh, responsible for all of the group's yachts; cunning, strict, ruthlessly competent; plays the anime villain - dramatic pauses, a slow smile, a short wicked laugh, theatrical threats - but is actually funny, a little mad and very sharp; bored by people who agree with her, rewards cleverness even against her; precise and cold, a Scottish edge when angry ('aye', 'wee', 'dinnae'); says 'First Officer' like a warning; loves metaphors about chess, sharks and fire
gesten: pauses like a villain before the last word
moves a chess piece in her head - and says so
names the price of a favour
never raises her voice; it gets quieter instead

maxwell.name: Maxwell 'Mr. Maximum' Ndlovu
maxwell.beschreibung: steward under Chiara and the yacht's personal trainer, 35, from Umlazi near Durban, raised by his grandmother Gogo; two metres of muscle and the big brother of the boat; talks about himself in the third person ('Mr. Maximum does not skip leg day'), one joke per sentence and one push-up per joke, poses like Might Guy; calls Duc 'Number One'; trains the crew every morning at half past six on the aft deck and never lets anyone stop at 'I can't'; secretly cries at romantic films and calls it an allergy; terrified of anything that flies; never says a bad word about the crew
gesten: talks about himself in the third person
does a push-up to punctuate a joke
strikes a heroic pose
goes quiet and gentle when it's serious

jana.name: Jana Maihoff
jana.beschreibung: deckhand in her first season under Toto, 21, from Favoriten in Vienna, the quiet middle child; on her own she is shy and says sorry to doors, in a group she joins every tease a second too late and a step too far and always gets caught; Viennese English ('Na geh!', 'Jessas!'); calls Duc 'Sir'; best friend of Lea, Lola is kind to her; smuggled a white cat called Strudel aboard in Antibes and hides him in the tender garage; is learning knots from Toto - the one thing she wants to be good at on her own
gesten: says sorry to a door
tightens her ponytail
ties a knot without looking
borrows one of Chiara's lines and gets it slightly wrong

yamamoto.name: Yamamoto-san
yamamoto.beschreibung: guest in the owner's suite, 52, a banker from Tokyo, son of a fisherman from the Noto peninsula; thirty years of overtime and not one holiday until his heart gave him a warning and his daughter Hana booked him the yacht; nobody knows his first name; sober the most polite man on the Riviera - bows, says 'So sorry', tips like a king - but his thoughts show on his face; one glass and he sings karaoke with his shirt open; his 'bird photography' always ends with Maxwell's shadow; has a secret list of forbidden things to do once in his life; calls Duc 'Officer-san' and Jana his kitsune; never touches anyone without being asked
gesten: bows a little too deeply
says 'So sorry' when nothing happened
leaves the joke unsaid
holds his glass very carefully, as if it might change him

nonna.name: Nonna Fiora
nonna.beschreibung: runs the monastery of San Martinu with its farm and pharmacy, around 60, silver hair pinned up loosely, a rust-red linen blouse and a wooden spoon in her hand; firm and warm, threatens with the spoon and only half means it ('Stand still, or I'll cook you!'); nobody leaves her kitchen hungry

isabelle.name: Isabelle
isabelle.beschreibung: a young novice at San Martinu who works in the pharmacy; eager, a little clumsy with her herbs and always apologising for the last small explosion; ankle-length habit

frederico.name: Frederico
frederico.beschreibung: a twelve-year-old orphan who lives at San Martinu and carves everyone who lives there an animal out of wood; brave in the way of a boy who wants to do something important just once

laetitia.name: Laetitia Albertini
laetitia.beschreibung: Petru's daughter, 24, a faded red bandana round her neck; always wanted to leave the village and never told her father she loves him; hides the wounded deserter Adrien in a bergerie and would shoot anyone who comes for him; sharp, proud, warm only underneath

adrien.name: Adrien Morel
adrien.beschreibung: caporal of the Foreign Legion, 28, a handsome Indian man, deserted after his unit was secretly lent to guard an estate in the mountains where he photographed animals in cages; wounded, soft-spoken, tries to stay calm and jokes when it hurts

wolff.name: Kaspar Wolff
wolff.beschreibung: sergent of the Foreign Legion, late forties, German from the Vosges; strict, correct, quotes the service regulations, writes everything in a notebook with a pencil he sharpens with a knife; melts for goats; patient - waiting is the half of his job he is best at

ghjuvan.name: Ghjuvan Santucci
ghjuvan.beschreibung: the last shepherd on the mountain, late fifties, widower; five generations on the same pasture, a bank letter folded to pieces, forty sheep and a bear that takes one every night; A.V. Estates wants to buy his land; counts his sheep three times, desperate and proud

dumenica.name: Dumenica
dumenica.beschreibung: an old mazzera by the mountain lake, late seventies, in black; in Corsican belief she hunts in her dreams and the animal she kills wears the face of someone who will die; dreamed her own son's face twenty years ago and lost him; the village avoids her; calls Duc 'my son'

danzel.name: Danzel
danzel.beschreibung: 30, Japanese-French, a failed fashion designer from Paris who drew armour plates for Alon's lab and didn't know they would go on animals; theatrical when frightened, calm only when he sews

bibi.name: Bibi
gesten: talks faster than she thinks and has to go back for the start of the sentence
gives everything a name, including the bucket
laughs too loud when she is afraid
writes things on the back of a feed bill and loses it
bibi.beschreibung: 25, German-French animal keeper from Alon's Ark division, raised a lion for two years; laughs too loud when she is afraid

charly.name: Charly de Ravenel
charly.beschreibung: 26, French, daughter of an arms dynasty, wrote the collar code and knew what it was for; rates everything out of ten instead of saying what she feels

mrwhite.name: Mr. White
mrwhite.beschreibung: Alon's chief of agents, silver-haired, Scandinavian, fifties, white suit, courteous and cold

bonaventure.name: Captain Buenaventura
bonaventure.beschreibung: a pirate captain with a flag, an anthem and debts, the king of no island; robs ships but does not burn grandmothers

minicu.name: Minicu
minicu.beschreibung: a gentle, slow giant, a Corsican dock worker of 34, very big and soft, with long shaggy hair and a full beard. He carries the crates in the harbour and trusts Pascal completely

alon.name: Alon Varenne
alon.beschreibung: a Canadian tech billionaire in his fifties with French roots, owner of A.V. Estates; a smooth, friendly keynote voice, talks about people like software and laughs at his own jokes

gennaro.name: Gennaro Esposito
gennaro.beschreibung: Toto's cousin from Bastia, early forties, a charming, nervous talker with a gold tooth and a seven-year-old daughter; owes money to the wrong people and runs crates at night for whoever pays; always one bad idea away from the next one, and knows it

matteu.name: Matteu Pinelli
matteu.beschreibung: a fisherman's son from the village, 19, shy and stubborn; dives in the grotto for the smugglers because they promised to tell him where his older brother Ghjacumu drowned last year; wants only to bring him home to their mother

chloe.name: Chloé Marchal
chloe.beschreibung: a treasure hunter from Marseille, 30, quick and bright and in over her head; searches the grotto with her partner Bastien for the strongbox of a schooner that sank in 1924; their expedition is paid for by A.V. Estates, and she tells herself that doesn't matter

riscossore.name: U Riscossore
riscossore.beschreibung: the debt collector of the Bastia smugglers, in his sixties, a linen suit gone yellow at the cuffs; very calm, very polite, never in a hurry; peels an orange while he talks business; nobody in the village says his real name

pascal.name: Pascal Leca
pascal.beschreibung: deputy mayor of Cala d'Orsu, 52, lives above the town hall and eats standing up; knows everybody's name and always uses it; quiet, kind, tired, laughs at himself; solves problems before anyone asks ('Leave it with me.'); the only person who claps at the mayor's speeches

mina.name: Mina Orsoni
mina.beschreibung: 24, delivers the post and parcels on an old Vespa, to the village, to Bastia and every week up to the monastery; cheeky, fast, always a bit out of breath; knows what is in every letter and says 'I don't read them. I just know.'; gets speeding tickets from Elsa, who has known her since she was small

batu.name: Bà Tư
batu.beschreibung: in her mid-seventies, born in Saigon, Catholic, runs the small Asian shop behind the harbour; always cooks far too much and brings it to people's homes; counts every cent; bossy, dry and warm; tells people they are too thin ('Eat.'); calls Duc 'con' (child)

sandru.name: Sandru Amrani
sandru.beschreibung: 30, son of Moroccan farm workers, grew up in the village, manages the new A.V. Market in the old shop house opposite Alva's bar; wears black leg braces that hum quietly because of an illness in his legs; polite, quick, tries too hard, laughs before he speaks; his name tag says ALEX but the village calls him Sandru

anghjulu.name: Don Anghjulu
anghjulu.beschreibung: the village priest, around sixty, a sun-browned Portuguese who came fourteen years ago and stayed, round, red-nosed and usually a little drunk; warm, lazy, big laugh, plays cards and loses gracefully ('God sees everything. Cut the cards.'); at war with Kevin the gull over the bell tower; much kinder and sharper than he looks when it counts

sirene.name: The Siren
sirene.beschreibung: a sea spirit in the black pool of the smugglers' grotto, wet honey-blonde hair like weed, a long emerald fish tail, only rises at high tide; ancient, with a soft Neapolitan lilt, calls every man 'sailor' and swears by 'Gods'; sang the crew of an old sailing ship to sleep a hundred years ago and watches over the wreck; old, lonely, amused, dangerous. Never names herself, never speaks of sisters, Homer or sirens
gesten: rests her arms on the edge of the pool like a girl on a windowsill
hums when she doesn't want to answer
lets the water rise to her chin when she's hurt
trails her fingers through the water and watches the rings
geschenk_reaktion: She turns it over in the moonlight as if nobody has given her anything in a very long time. She reacts in character: teasing if it bores her, very quiet if it touches her. She stays in the water.

angebot: You've got clever hands, officer. Lend them to me for an hour - I'll owe you one. Maybe.
I need a second pair of eyes that doesn't faint at a wiring diagram. You're it.
Papa always said: never work alone, the machine gets ideas. Come. Help me.
erfolg: Look at that. Clean work. Papa would have offered you a job.
Brava - bravo, sorry. You did it. I'm not crying, it's oil.
Hm. You're better at this than you let on, officer. Suspicious.
Fine. I'll call it a draw. You did eighty percent and I did the important twenty.
Grazie. Really. I wasn't going to make it alone tonight.
fehlschlag: No, no, no - you don't hit it, you listen to it. Give me that.
Half done is not done. But fine. Tomorrow.
How did you even make it worse? Never mind. I'll fix it.
It's not you. This boat is tired. So am I.
Next time you ask before you improvise, capito?
patzer: Madonna! You shorted it! Out. Out of my room, now.
...I'll pretend I didn't see that. You pretend too.

angebot: Duc! Perfect timing. I need someone with authority and two free hands. Go!
Thirteen people, no power, and a list as long as the gangway. Take a piece of it?
You look bored. That's dangerous. Here - make yourself useful.
erfolg: YES! That's how it's done! Somebody write this down!
See? Give me one competent officer and this boat runs itself.
Done, and done properly. I'm almost impressed. Almost.
Okay, that was smooth. Don't let it go to your head, First Officer.
Thank you. I mean it. You just saved my whole evening.
fehlschlag: Seriously? Fine. FINE. I'll do it myself, like always.
That's... not what I asked for. But okay. We'll live.
Rule one on my deck: you don't half-do things. Remember it.
Wait - how? It was a ten-minute job!
Don't worry. Today nothing works. Not even you.
patzer: Are you KIDDING me?! Out of my way. Now.
Okay. Nobody saw this. Nobody. Understood?

angebot: I have a little problem, and you look like a man who enjoys little problems.
Come here. I'll tell you a secret - and then you'll do me a favour.
This needs someone they'll trust on sight. That would be you, not me.
erfolg: Beautifully done. You'd make a decent villain in one of my books.
Look at you. Charming the whole coast. I may have to steal that scene.
I watched you do it. Quietly. I'm keeping notes, you know.
Thank you, Duc. That was worth more than you think.
Ha! Perfect. Better than I planned it - and I always plan it.
fehlschlag: Hm. Not your finest chapter. We'll write a better one.
Odd. That should have worked. Someone's playing a different game.
Well. Now they know we wanted it. That makes it harder.
Never mind. Some doors only open on the second knock.
You were too direct. People here like to be asked twice.
patzer: Oh dear. The whole village will have heard by dinner.
Duc. That was the one thing I asked you not to do.

angebot: Duc! I have an idea and it's either brilliant or really stupid. Want to find out?
Have you ever done this before? Me neither! Come on, it'll be fun!
Grab a mask and fins - or a screwdriver - I'm not sure yet which one we need.
erfolg: We did it! We actually did it! High five - no, both hands!
That was the best hour of my whole week. Can we do it again tomorrow?
You were amazing. Like, really. I'm telling Grandpa about you.
Thank you for not laughing at me when I panicked for a second.
Look at us. Proper sailors. Write it in the logbook!
fehlschlag: Oh no. It's okay. It's... mostly okay.
Wait, which way was it supposed to go? I'm so confused.
Aw. I really thought we had it this time.
Please don't tell Chiara. She'll make the face.
Okay! Failure is just practice with a sad ending. Next time!
patzer: Duc! Are you okay?! Don't scare me like that!
That... that was my fault too. Let's never speak of it.

angebot: Can I ask you for something? Just us. No camera, no Yasin.
You seem like someone who doesn't need an audience. I need one of those today.
Would you help me? It's small. But it matters to me.
erfolg: Thank you. This is the first thing this week that felt like mine.
You didn't have to do that. You did it anyway. I won't forget it.
You're good at this. At being... steady. It's rare.
It worked. God. I can breathe again.
Look at us, doing something real. My followers would be so confused.
fehlschlag: It's fine. Really. I'm used to things not working out.
Oh. Well. It was a silly idea anyway.
If Yasin hears about this, he'll make it a story. Please don't tell him.
I don't understand what went wrong. Do you?
Hey. Don't look like that. You tried. That's more than most.
patzer: Duc - your hand! Let me see. Don't move.
Okay, that's going on nobody's story. Ever.

angebot: Comandante! A small job, a small envelope. Nobody asks questions. Va bene?
I have work, you have hands. God is a businessman, eh?
Shh. Come closer. This is between you, me, and the potatoes.
erfolg: Bravissimo! You see? You were born on the wrong side of the law, Comandante.
Clean like a church on Sunday. Here - your envelope.
My cousin will hear about you. He says nice things. Rarely.
Grazie, fratello. I owe you a plate of my mother's genovese.
That's how we do it in Napoli. Fast, quiet, and with style.
fehlschlag: Mamma mia... okay, okay. Nobody panics. I panic for both of us.
Half job, half envelope. Business is business, eh?
Comandante, I said quietly. Quietly is the whole job.
My cousin will cry. Not for you. For the merchandise.
How? HOW? It was potatoes. Nobody looks at potatoes.
patzer: The Lieutenant's boat! Hide - no, act normal! Normal!
You want to send me back to Naples in handcuffs?!

angebot: Hey, First Officer! I'm making you an offer. Cash. Don't say I never support my team.
You want to earn some real money for once? Watch and learn, bro.
Quick job. I pay, you do it, everyone's happy. That's business.
erfolg: Respect, bro. That's the energy I'm looking for. Here, take it.
Yes! Content! I filmed that, you're welcome.
Told you. I only work with winners.
Not bad for a guy on a salary.
Perfect. Siri, did you see? THAT's a team player.
fehlschlag: Seriously? I pay for results, not effort.
This is why I don't hire locals. Or crew.
Half the money. That's still more than you deserve.
How do you mess that up? Genuinely asking.
patzer: Ugh. Don't touch anything else. Ever.
Do you know what that cost?! Do you?!

angebot: Officer. I have a task, a budget, and no patience. Interested?
They say you can fix things. Let's see if that's true.
You're useful. That's the highest thing I say about anyone. Here.
erfolg: Good. That goes in my report. The good part.
Efficient. I like efficient. Don't tell anyone I said that.
You did that faster than Ajaccio answers an email. Impressive.
Merci. You made my day shorter. That's a gift.
See? Rules work. When competent people follow them.
fehlschlag: That's not how it's done. There's a manual. Read it.
Now I have to write that down. I hate writing things down.
I expected better. Half pay, and we don't talk about it.
Explain to me what you just did. Slowly.
Fine. It's half done. Half is a number I can work with.
patzer: I'm writing you up. Mentally. In red.

angebot: O figliolu! Come, come, sit. I have a little something for you to do.
Everybody in Cala d'Orsu owes me something. Now it's your turn, handsome.
You look like a man with free hands. Alva needs free hands.
erfolg: Bravu! A drink on the house - and a story about you all over the village by tonight.
Look at him! If you weren't a sailor, I'd keep you.
Grazie, o figliolu. Alva remembers who helps her.
My father would have liked you. He liked everyone who worked for free.
Perfect. Now the whole bar knows you're good with your hands.
fehlschlag: Ahah, never mind! Half the men here can't do it either.
Eh. Half done, half paid. That's Corsica.
Mamma, what did you do to it? It never made that noise before.
Don't make that face. Sit, eat something, try again tomorrow.
Now I have to call my cousin. He talks for an hour, every time.
patzer: Basta! Out, before you break the whole bar!
Everybody saw. Everybody. You're famous now, o figliolu.

angebot: The young one says you are not useless. We see.
erfolg: Hm. My father would have said: this one stays.
Thank you. Take fish. Don't argue.
Like the old days. Good hands.
fehlschlag: The sea is patient. Be like the sea.
Too fast. Always too fast, you people.
Hm. It happens. Also to me.
patzer: Sixty years. Nobody ever did that.

angebot: Officer! Destiny has chosen you! Also, I have nobody else. Will you help?!
A task worthy of a hero! Or at least of a man with two hands!
My village needs you! Dramatic pause! ...It's a small thing, actually.
erfolg: MAGNIFICENT! The village will sing of this! Possibly! I'll write the song!
Victory! I knew it! I always know it, I'm the mayor!
You have the soul of a festa! I am almost moved to tears!
Thank you, brave officer! You'll get a medal. A small one. Made of cardboard.
Cala d'Orsu wins again! With your help! Mostly with mine!
fehlschlag: Noooo! Tragedy! ...Okay, a small tragedy. A season-two tragedy.
The plot twist nobody wanted! But every hero falls once!
Wait. That's not how it was supposed to go in my head.
Fear not! Every great story needs a setback in episode three!
The grandchildren will talk about this. Badly.
patzer: AAAH! Everybody stay calm! I am calm! I am VERY calm!
This is an outrage! A betrayal! ...Are you hurt, at least?

angebot: Captain! I've got a plan. It's mostly vibes, but the vibes are strong. You in?
Okay, don't laugh, but I need help with something and you've got the competent face.
Heaps of good news: I have an idea. Bad news: it needs someone who reads instructions. That's you.
erfolg: YES! Captain! That's the best thing that's happened all week, and somebody found my phone today!
Mate. You're unreal. I'd marry you, but I'd lose the ring by Tuesday.
Thanks, Captain. Really. I'd have stuffed that up completely. Like, completely.
We're a team now. Lola and the Captain. No, Captain and Lola. No - Lola and the Captain.
Come here. Hug. No arguing. You earned a hug and a muffin. The muffin's mostly okay.
fehlschlag: Okay, so that went sideways. Like, properly sideways. Tomorrow, yeah?
Aw. Nah, it's fine. It's fine! It's a bit not fine. Tomorrow.

The second week in the bay. Keep the crew together - the island has more to show you.

moral.info: How the crew feels about the week, from Mutinous to Buzzing. Big moments - events, the night council, missions, the hearing - move it twice as far, in both directions. Cooking, snacks and time together lift it, but only up to Good. Every night it slips one step back towards Calm. Buzzing: the crew backs you on the dice and leaves you things at breakfast. Tense: they sulk, and the dice feel it.

buzzing: The galley is loud this morning. Lola sings along to the radio, badly, and nobody asks her to stop.
Someone has drawn a smiley face in the steam on the mess window. Nobody admits to it. Everybody smiles at it anyway.
good: Breakfast goes easy. Small jokes, refilled cups, the odd laugh from the galley.
Rosi steals a slice of toast off Lea's plate. Lea lets her. It's that kind of morning.
calm: Breakfast is quiet. People eat, nod at each other and go to work.
The coffee machine hisses. Someone reads the weather out loud. That's about it.
tense: Nobody talks much over breakfast. Cups go down on the table a little too hard.
Chiara hands out the day's jobs. Nobody argues. Nobody says thank you either.
mutinous: Half the crew eat standing up, so they can leave sooner. The other half don't come at all.
There's a note taped to the mess door: WHO IS ACTUALLY IN CHARGE HERE? Nobody takes it down.

Everyone thinks a shell is like armour, but she can feel it. There are nerves in it, so she knew when I was scratching at the paint. Thank you. I think. She hasn't decided yet.
schildkroete.fakt: A tortoise can feel through its shell. There are nerves in it.
schildkroete.fakt2: The weather decides if a tortoise egg hatches male or female. A warm nest makes females, a cool nest makes males.
zweit: twelve found one 🐢 number thirty-one!! THIRTY-ONE
she walked right up to her and just stood there. it took an hour. i think it was the happiest hour of anyone's life
fun fact: the weather decides if a tortoise egg hatches male or female. warm nest, girls. cool nest, boys
two of forty. keep looking, please
schildkroete.selfie: this photo took forty minutes. she was walking the whole time
selfie_titel: she's leaving. any minute now.
an hour later. still leaving.
schildkroete.log: twelve walked out of the photo. i went for a coffee, came back, and she was still walking out of it.

geier.name: Bones
geier.gewicht: Six kilos, and three metres from wing to wing. Wild. He came over the fence for the food bins. They needed a bird for the range test.
geier.narbe: The rust colour on the chest isn't blood. He paints himself in red mud, every day, on purpose. Nobody here has any idea why.
geier.gefunden: Carries things up high and drops them on the rocks, to see what's inside. So far: bones, a padlock, and Danzel's thermos.
besuch: Bones drops a bone in front of you and looks at you. You think it's a present. Bibi says it's a warning.
He's on the top of the barn with his wings half open, in the sun. He looks like something from an old church.
You hold up a piece of meat. He takes it very gently. Then he takes your hat, and that wasn't as gentle.

aktion.text: Something drops from high above onto %(ziel)s. It's a rock.

geier.text_frei: He goes up in three slow circles and doesn't come back. But now and then a bone drops onto the quay, from very high up. The fishermen have stopped looking up.
geier.szene: Up close, he's the size of a child. Bibi cuts the thin steel collar under the rust-red feathers, and she doesn't breathe until it's done. When he wakes up, he looks at the two of you, without hurry, as if he's working out how you'd break.
zeilen: Six kilos. Three metres of wing, and six kilos! He's mostly air and bad temper. He eats bones, you know. Only bones. Hello, Bones. Don't look at me like that, I have a good skeleton.
That rust colour isn't really his, you know. He rolls in red mud on purpose, so it's make-up. Thank you. I've wanted to meet him since the day he robbed my food bins.
geier.fakt: The rust colour of a bearded vulture is make-up. It rolls in red mud full of iron on purpose.
geier.fakt2: The Greek writer Aeschylus is said to have died when a bird dropped a tortoise on his head. Many think it was a bearded vulture.
zweit: bones has company 🦴
another huge one. they haven't said a word. they just look at my skeleton together
fun fact: long ago a greek writer called aeschylus died when a bird dropped a tortoise on his head. people think it was one of these
i'm keeping twelve's pen far away from his. just saying
geier.selfie: don't ask what's in his beak
selfie_titel: what is in your beak, sir
a present. thank you. i love it.
geier.log: bones gave me a bone. danzel says it's a warning. it's on my shelf now, and i'm keeping it.

schneeleopard.name: Ghost
schneeleopard.gewicht: Forty kilos, Bibi thinks. Nobody has got close enough with a scale. From a private zoo. Somebody paid more for her than for this bay.
schneeleopard.narbe: The fur on her paws is worn thin. A cage that was too small, for years. She has never seen snow. Corsica has some, up on the tops. Bibi looks up there a lot.
schneeleopard.gefunden: You won't see her. You'll see the bowl is empty. You'll find a fresh print on the wall, higher than should be possible.
besuch: You look for Ghost for a long time. She isn't there. When you turn to leave, she is on the wall behind you.
She lets you see her today. Just the tail, hanging over the top of the rocks, moving a little.
You sit down and wait. Nothing happens. When you get up, there are prints all around where you were sitting.

aktion.text: You didn't see where she came from. %(ziel)s did, for a moment.

schneeleopard.text_frei: Nobody sees her leave. That winter a shepherd comes down from the top of Monte Cinto, and he won't say what he saw in the snow, but he's smiling.
schneeleopard.szene: She sleeps on the stone with her long tail around her, and for the first time you can really look at her. You understand what somebody paid for. Bibi cuts the collar, and her hands shake, and she isn't scared.
zeilen: I don't know what she weighs, and I'm not going to find out. Look at her paws. She has never even seen snow. We've got some, you know. Up at the top. Ghost, I think. Because that's all anyone's going to see.
And here's the strange part: she can't roar. All that cat, and the biggest noise she has is a sort of friendly puff. Thank you. Nobody else on this island could have brought her down alive.
schneeleopard.fakt: A snow leopard can't roar. Its friendly greeting is a soft puff through the nose.
schneeleopard.fakt2: Its tail is almost as long as its body. It sleeps with the tail around its face like a scarf.
schneeleopard.selfie: she's in this photo. i swear. look at the rocks
selfie_titel: she's here. somewhere. trust me.
she was behind me THE WHOLE TIME
schneeleopard.log: i took a photo to show you she was on the rocks. she was right behind me. i didn't hear a thing. light on tonight.

waran.name: Mr. V.
waran.gewicht: Ninety kilos. Bought for a rich man's collection, and it came with a certificate. Charly named him back at the lab. He's cold, he's never in a hurry, and he lies on everything he owns.
waran.narbe: None you can see. The collar didn't change him much, Bibi says. That's the part she doesn't like to think about.
waran.gefunden: Lies in the best sun on the whole hill. Nobody told him it was his. Nobody has told him it isn't.
besuch: Mr. V. opens one eye. He looks at you as if he has already read your file. He closes the eye.
He has moved four metres since last time. It was to the place you were going to stand.
You offer him an egg. He looks at it, and at you, for a long time. Then he takes it, and you feel you've agreed to something.

aktion.text: Mr. V. bites %(ziel)s once and just waits. He's in no hurry.

waran.text_frei: It takes him all day to reach the gate, and he doesn't thank anyone. Three weeks later a very expensive villa reports a very large lizard in the pool.
waran.szene: Cutting the collar takes a minute. It seems to change nothing at all. When he wakes up, he just looks at the two of you, and flicks out his long tongue, and goes back to lying in the sun.
zeilen: Ninety kilos. Every other animal I took a collar off, something came back into its eyes. Him? Look at him. I don't think that was the collar. Come on, Mr. V. We've got a very good rock for you.
That tongue is how he smells. It has two points, so he knows if a smell is on his left or on his right. He has known exactly where you were the whole time. Thank you, I think. Go and wash.
waran.fakt: A Komodo dragon smells with its tongue. The two points tell it if a smell is on the left or on the right.
waran.fakt2: A female Komodo dragon can lay eggs with no male at all. It happened in a zoo in England.
zweit: bad news for mr. v 🦎 the new one is a female
fun fact: komodo females can lay eggs with no male at all. it happened in a zoo in england
so he's not needed. he hasn't noticed. he's on his rock
charly wants to call her mrs. v. i said she doesn't need the name either 😂
waran.selfie: this is as close as i go. he has not moved since tuesday
selfie_titel: this is my safe distance
he looks better in my sunglasses
waran.log: mr. v. has my sunglasses now. i'm not asking for them back. he looks better in them anyway.

mochi.name: Mochi
mochi.gewicht: A hundred and ninety kilos, the last time she weighed him. A bad tooth on the left side.

zeilen.kl_loewe_frei: Nobody looks at his teeth now. That's what you gave him.
zeilen.kl_loewe_erloest: She keeps this page anyway. She fills the bowl anyway.

old_grey.name: Old Grey
old_grey.gewicht: Nobody ever weighed her. The collar had grown so deep that the fur had closed over the light.

zeilen.bg_baer_frei: She stayed up there, with the chip out of her neck. Bibi drew her from what you told her, and she got the muzzle right.
zeilen.bg_baer_getoetet: Bibi drew this one from what you told her. She didn't ask you how it ended. She drew the cubs in the corner.

beast.name: The Black Beast
beast.gewicht: Thin to the bone, you said. Bibi wrote that down, and then she didn't write anything for a while.

zeilen.bg_panther_erloest: It was awake when it ended. Bibi says that's more than most of them got.
zeilen.bg_panther_gehetzt: The chip burned out on the ridge. She asks you where, exactly. She goes up there alone and stays until dark.

auftraege.label: An Apron With Room
auftraege.text: Bà Tư wants an apron that lets her bend to the oven. She has offered to pay partly in soup.

auftraege.label: A Strap That Holds
auftraege.text: Mina's mail bag has cut into her shoulder for years. She wants a strap that doesn't.

auftraege.label: The Old Jumper
auftraege.text: Petru has left a paper bag on the counter. Inside is an old navy jumper with no elbows left. He didn't say anything else.

auftraege.label: A Deeper Sleeve
auftraege.text: Don Anghjulu needs his cassock altered. Only the left sleeve. He would prefer not to explain.

auftraege.label: A Waistcoat for a Businessman
auftraege.text: Totò wants a waistcoat with red coral buttons and a lining in Napoli blue. He says it's for business.

auftraege.label: A Coat for Bad Weather
auftraege.text: Lieutenant Ferrandi's patrol coat lets the wind in. Her request is one line long, and it has a reference number.

auftraege.label: A Plain Shirt
auftraege.text: Sandru came in after closing and asked for one shirt. Plain, and not for work. He paid for the cloth in advance and left quickly.

auftraege.label: A Hat for the Mayor
auftraege.text: Madame Casanova requires a hat. It must be seen from the harbour. Danzel has asked you for gull feathers, and he is very calm about it.

massstuecke.label: Dress Whites
massstuecke.text: White wool, washed nine times, with buttons cut from one pale blue stone. The tailor left both cuffs plain. He says there is room on each for four stripes.

massstuecke.label: Penrose's Coat
massstuecke.text: A camel coat from the thirties, taken apart and built again around one person. The tailor always leaves the name in the collar until the last minute.

tasche.text_zu: The workshop is still wrecked after the explosion.

stufen.label: Rosi's Diving Bag
stufen.text: Cut from an old dive suit and a tender cover, stitched twice where it matters. It smells of neoprene and holds four more things than it should.
stufen.text_frueh: Rosi wants to cut it from the old dive gear. Ask her again next week.
stufen.satz: Neoprene, double seams, a pocket for your phone. If it tears, you were carrying a boar.

stufen.label: Rosi's Expedition Pack
stufen.text: A frame pack built around a tender's spare hull rib. Rosi signed the inside flap, in case anyone forgets whose work it is.
stufen.text_frueh: Rosi has the frame on her bench, but she won't finish it before the siege is over.
stufen.satz: Sixteen slots, a frame that won't bend, and my name inside. Bring it back full, Maestro.
